### ✨ New Features

* **YouTube:** Add `Android Auto parked app mode` patch ([#4930](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/issues/4930)) ([2ed659c](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/2ed659c623e700083bd0e998a1ece9f943a73cb3))
* **YouTube:** Add `Open post images in fullscreen` patch ([#4963](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/issues/4963)) ([f7ae0fd](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/f7ae0fd0ff66cfef839aa4059041c4bc7a21ad27))
* **YouTube:** Add `Ungroup notifications` patch ([#4896](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/issues/4896)) ([659cba4](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/659cba4547f33354596576633fd366101811ddc6))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Reddit - Settings:** Toggles do not match the app toggles ([#4964](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/issues/4964)) ([1e915bd](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/1e915bd1e7ff170474b730dc3deb8fca9fc03df3))
* **YouTube - Ambient mode:** Enhanced Ambient mode shows a black bar around the comment box after the comments were closed with the back button ([afcb500](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/afcb500d48e3b5258b644bee9e70236badc3843d))
* **YouTube - Ambient mode:** Enhanced Ambient mode shows the video through a panel that is dragged up over the player ([343e2c0](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/343e2c0f33fe4676e9270295db619ba6756aff5c))

* **YouTube - Hide layout components:** "Hide view count" and "Hide upload time" do not work with newer layouts, channel pages, playlists, podcasts and shows ([463914f](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/463914f0ac1424d3bdbf4a388f42dfd0b6e15127))
* **YouTube - Navigation bar:** Glass navigation bar buttons are pushed out of the capsule in incognito mode ([#4971](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/issues/4971)) ([73fbfde](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/73fbfde660a6c351f9bd3832dbd161a9556b34bc))
* **YouTube - Open system share sheet:** In-app share sheet opens for videos made for kids ([f44dac3](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/f44dac3ab5ef54e9ad1f62b073e658c7ef3da68c))
* **YouTube - Restore old video action bar:** Save button in the More menu of the action bar has no icon ([e1608cd](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/e1608cd60e1a832c68119ab1e87a36018c17b840))
* **YouTube - Return YouTube Dislike:** Feed thumbnail like count shows the old like icon instead of the rounded icon of the like button ([35bbf02](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/35bbf02c31a6701a1fcbc084604973bc9d1506c8))
* **YouTube - Spoof video streams:** Mobile Web client plays the previous live stream after switching to another live stream or video ([46b7b62](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/46b7b622b255bd3ff8e711c549bca00cdce9794f))
* **YouTube - Spoof video streams:** Mobile Web client shows overlapping frames when a live stream starts and fails the playback after seeking back ([ef1a5ff](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/ef1a5ff0c253dec4dafaef5c03a35f6b6e622bd7))

* **YouTube - Spoof video streams:** SABR clients buffer far more media ahead than the app player config allows, which can run the app out of memory on long videos ([e1eaba5](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/e1eaba5d910adedd17aad5ca127512ad71ea2932))
* **YouTube - Swipe controls:** "Enable haptic feedback" is available without "Enable press to swipe gesture", the only gesture it applies to ([9105f1f](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/9105f1fa5128fe5f252949528d666c2bb36a97c6))
* **YouTube - Translate posts:** Translated text is smaller than the original text ([#4972](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/issues/4972)) ([82c50c3](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/82c50c30fbdfb9e17fa89964646a7a549b1616e2))
* **YouTube Music - Change miniplayer color:** Miniplayer keeps the album color after dismissing the queue ([f60b4d1](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/f60b4d112c9e4a4bdef7a84d25d20967169c451b))
* **YouTube Music - Enable swipe to dismiss miniplayer:** Miniplayer comes back after dismissing it ([8dfb2e4](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/8dfb2e478aafdfb7667662f24e94f1c6468bcfd7))

This one moves to Facebook 587.0.0.39.55 and needs Morphe Manager 2.6.0 or newer, so update Manager and grab the new Facebook APK before you repatch. Long posts and comments can fold at however many lines you pick, and a video you started can keep playing after you leave Facebook. Facebook's new Repost button can go too. Reels can fill a tall screen, watched stories can move to the end of the tray, the location page you get after signing in is skipped, and there's a Hushfacebook icon for the home screen and notifications. The settings come in Thai now. On the fix side, reels with a "Popular near you" line show their date again, and a post you hid stays hidden when you refresh.

New in this release

- New patch, `Fold long text`. Pick how many lines a long post or comment shows before See more, anywhere from 1 to 20. `Fold long posts` is under News feed and `Fold long comments` under Comments and writing. Both start at Facebook's choice, which leaves the fold where Facebook puts it, and while `Show full post text` is on, posts still show whole. (#497)

- `Hide Repost under posts` under News feed and `Hide Repost on reels` under Reels and Watch take Facebook's new Repost button, the two arrows next to Share, off posts and reels. Like, Comment and Share keep their own switches. Both start off. (#450)

- New patch, `Keep playing in the background`. A video you started with a tap keeps its sound after you leave Facebook, through the background player and notification Facebook already has, and the notification can pause it. Swiping the notification away stops it, and so does a call. A video Facebook started by itself, or one you paused before leaving, stays stopped. Its second switch, `Background play button in the window`, adds a headphones button to the picture-in-picture window. Tap it and the window closes while the sound keeps going, even with the first switch off. Both switches start off, under Video and audio. (#455)

- `Full player button by the speaker` under Video and audio moves a feed video's full player button down to the video's bottom corner, where Facebook's speaker button was, and slides the speaker over to make room. Live videos and videos without the speaker keep it up top. It needs `Full player button on feed videos` and starts off. (#431)

- With `Queue reel saves` on, holding Download on a reel asks how many to save, from 10 to 150. That reel goes in the reel queue, then Hushfacebook swipes to each next reel and queues it too, until it has them all or the reels run out. It waits while the queue is paused or full. Hold Download again, or cancel the queue, to stop it early. (#449)

- `Hold a feed photo to react` and `Hold a feed video to react` under News feed open a post's reactions when you hold its photo or its video, the same way holding Like does. Slide to one and let go, or let go and tap one. Their `Reaction` list can pick one reaction instead (Love, Haha and the rest), and then holding a post gives that one right away. Both go ahead of `Long press opens comments`, and with `Hold a feed video for 2x` on, holding a video still plays it fast. If you had the old single switch on, both start on for you. They're part of `Open comments with a gesture` and start off. (#454)

- `Dark box behind folded captions` under Reels and Watch puts the same dark box behind a reel's caption while it's folded, the short one with more at the end. Turn it on along with `Dark box behind open captions` and every caption gets the box. It's off until you turn it on. (#472)

- A switch you turn off in `Switches that are on` now stays in the list, off, until you close it, so a wrong tap is one more tap to undo. The next time you open the list it waits under `Turned off lately` at the bottom, newest first and up to 20 of them, and one tap turns it back on. Turn one on anywhere and it leaves that group. (#470)

- `Fill the screen with reels` under Reels and Watch zooms a reel in a little so it reaches the top and bottom of a tall screen, instead of sitting between black bars. A bit of the sides gets cut off. Only reels where that's a small slice fill, so 4:5 and square posts keep their whole picture. A reel stays filled after you close its comments, too. A landscape video you open full screen fills the same way when the cut is small. Pinch in on a filled reel or video to see all of it, or pinch out to fill it again. It keeps its pinched size until you scroll away from it. It's off until you turn it on. (#453, #456, #466)

- `Hide post cards between reels` under Reels and Watch takes out the carousels of posts Facebook slips in between reels, like "Catch up on conversations" from your groups. It's part of `Clean up Reels` and starts off. (#441)

- `Hide stories you scrolled past` under Stories takes a story out of Home's Stories tray once its tile has been on screen, even if you never opened it. It stays while you're still scrolling and leaves the next time you open Facebook. When that person posts a new story, they're back. Topic tiles like a game or a show work the same way and come back once a new story joins them. It starts off. (#463)

- Tapping the reel queue's notification opens Downloads in Hushfacebook settings, where every reel in the queue has its own row, in the order they'll save. Each row says who posted the reel and whether it's saving, waiting or paused, with its own Pause (or Resume) and Cancel. A paused reel keeps its place while the rest go on, and pausing the one that's saving stops it and puts it back at the front. (#462)

- `Icon style` in Hushfacebook settings has a new `Hushfacebook` look. It draws Hushfacebook's blue H logo as the home screen icon, so your patched copy is easy to tell apart from the official app, and the themed icon on Android 13 and up shows the H too. (#467)

- New `Notification icon` option in Hushfacebook settings. Pick `Hushfacebook` when you patch and Facebook's notifications and status bar icon show the H instead of the "f". Icons that say what a notification is about, like a friend request's, stay. (#467)

- `Use the Hushfacebook logo` sits under `Home header picture` in Appearance and puts Hushfacebook's logo at the top of Home in place of your words or Facebook's logo. `Remove the header picture` takes it off again. (#467)

- The Hush settings now come in Thai, translated by MangaThatsFine. (#436)

- New patch, `Post menu items`. `3-dot menu items to hide` under News feed lists the rows of a post's three-dot menu, like Interested, Not interested, Cast or Report, and the ones you tick stop showing up there, so a thumb can't land on them by accident. The list also picks up any other rows Facebook has shown you. A reel's More sheet follows the same list, so Save, Copy link or Report picked once leave both menus, and the reel's own rows, like Clear mode, join the list the first time a reel shows them. Nothing is hidden until you pick. (#475)

- `Refresh rate` under Appearance, in every build, asks your screen for its highest refresh rate while Facebook is open, or for a fixed rate from 60 up to 144 or 165 Hz. The list only shows the rates your screen has, and your phone's own refresh rate setting still sets the most Facebook gets. It starts at `As Facebook has it`. (#480)

- New `Hide the comment box` under Comments and writing. The Write a comment box at the bottom of a post's comments goes away, so you can read them without it. Off by default. (#479)

- New `Hide badges like Top fan on comments` under Comments and writing takes Top fan, Subscriber and the other badges off commenters' names. The name and the comment stay. It starts off. (#485)

- New `Hide the skip seconds` switch under Reels and Watch, right below `Double tap to skip`. A double tap on the edge of a reel or video still skips, but the +5s or -10s Facebook flashes over it doesn't show. It works on accounts where Facebook turned the skip on by itself too. It starts off. (#476)

- `Hide the full-screen and PiP buttons` under Reels and Watch takes the full-screen arrows and the picture-in-picture button off videos that play in the feed and in search results, like a Live that's already ended. (#478)

- `Ask before following from a post` under News feed and `Ask before following from a reel` under Reels and Watch make a tap on Follow ask first, so a stray tap doesn't follow someone. In a post that's the Follow link next to the poster's name and the Follow button on a shared Page or profile, and on a reel it's the Follow next to the author or a collaborator. Only Continue follows. Unfollow asks too. Both start off. (#477)

- `Reset settings`, next to `Import settings`, turns every switch and choice that `Export settings` saves back to how a new install has them, right away. `Undo the reset` below it puts yours back. Pause, debug logging and the update check stay as they are. (#483)

- `Show every reaction on comments` under Comments and writing brings back the row with Like, Reply and every reaction next to a comment's count, on accounts where Facebook changed it to show only the top reaction. It starts off. (#241)

- New `Hide the Add friend pop-up on shared reels` under Reels and Watch. When someone who isn't your friend sends you a reel, opening it no longer brings up the sheet asking you to add them. It starts off. (#486)

- New `Move seen stories to the end` on the Stories page. Stories you've already watched go after the ones you haven't, so the new ones come first in the tray. A story you're watching keeps its place until you close it. It starts off. (#489)

- `Full length on the seek bar` under Video and audio shows a feed video's whole length at the right end of its seek bar, where the time left was. A 41 second video that reads -0:12 left now reads 0:41 there. It needs `Times on the seek bar` on and starts off. (#487)

- `Thin line seek bar` under Video and audio draws a feed video's seek bar as a thin line right on its bottom edge, like the one on Instagram. There's no dot and no times until you drag it. Live videos get the line too while they can be rewound, and letting go at the far right end takes you back to live. Facebook's speaker and tagged people buttons move up above it. Reels and stories keep their own bars. A double tap to skip on a live feed video now moves it too, where Facebook's player used to drop the jump. It needs `Seek bar on feed videos` on and starts off. (#431)

- `Dark box behind story names` under Stories and `Dark box behind reel names` under Reels and Watch put the dark caption box behind the names in the stories row, on an open story and at the bottom of a reel, so a bright picture doesn't hide them. `Box darkness` picks how dark every box is, from 10 to 100 percent, and `Soft box edges` fades the boxes out at their edges. All of them start off. (#490)

- New patch, `Skip location prompts`. The full-screen page asking you to allow Location Services, the one with Skip and Continue you get after signing in, doesn't show anymore. It's on by default. Turn it off under Privacy when you do want Facebook to ask for your location. (#498)

Fixes

- `Show the post date on reels` now dates reels where Facebook says why it suggested them, like "Popular near you". In the Reels tab that reason took the whole line under the poster and pushed the date off, so those reels showed no date with the switch on. The date stays on that line now. (#496)

- `Show the post date on reels` also dates reels without sound. A silent reel has no song line, and Facebook's "Reel has no sound" label sat in its place with no date. The date goes in front of that label now, the way it does a song's. (#496)

- With `Keep the progress bar` on, a live video's chat shows up again. On Facebook 586 the switch held back more than the controls' hide timer, so the chat folded into a thin strip at the edge of the screen and only came back with Hushfacebook paused. Now it only stops that timer. (#447)

- With `Keep the progress bar` on, a video's seek bar and buttons stay up in the portrait full-screen viewer too, like on a past live or a reel's details with the panel closed. There they faded about 3 seconds after you tapped. A second tap still hides them.

- A reel on the Reels tab now reaches the bottom of the screen. With the tab bar at the top it started behind the bar but kept the height of the space under it, so the next reel peeked in at the bottom, even more with `Hide the status bar` on. With the tabs at the bottom, `Hide the status bar` and see-through bars left a black band under the reel with the next one showing below it. (#466, #494)

- With `Keep feed position on return` on, opening Facebook fresh loads the feed the way it always does. A cold start was treated like coming back to the feed, so it held an old copy of the feed instead of getting new posts, and now and then Home stayed empty until you scrolled. Coming back to Facebook, or to the feed from another screen, still keeps your place. (#493)

- `Show every reaction on comments` now covers the comments under a post you've opened and the ones shown under posts in your feed. Those rows kept showing only the top reaction even with the switch on, since Facebook picks them in two other places. (#241)

- With `Show every reaction on comments` on, a comment's count shows up to three reaction icons again. Some accounts still got just the top one beside the count, even on the row with Like and Reply. (#241)

- `Loop stories` now replays video stories too. A finished video used to sit on its last frame with a full bar while only photo stories started over, and the replay button on a held story had the same problem. (#380)

- A post you hide from the feed, with Hide post or "Hide all from" someone, stays hidden when you pull down to refresh. It used to come right back. Undo still brings it back. (#444)

- `Report a problem` leaves the "What went wrong?" box empty now, so you can type straight into it. It used to come pre-filled with two questions, and on a phone that box looked done (or wouldn't take typing at all). The questions show in it as a grey hint instead. (#488)

- `Hide the X on posts` takes the X off the Reels row in your feed too, next to its three-dot menu. The menu stays. (#389)

- Morphe Manager now treats a copy made with `Clone install under another package name` as a clone, with the Clone chip on its card. If you changed the copy's package name in that patch's options, type it in again before you repatch, because Manager won't carry the old one over. The app name you picked stays. (#474)

- With `View stories anonymously` and `Hide seen stories` on, a Highlights tile in the Stories tray that you watched all the way through leaves the tray like any other watched story. Highlights don't run on a story's 24 hours, so the check for a newer story never let them go. (#165)

- The black bar that sometimes stuck under the floating tab bar in Marketplace, even while scrolling, goes away by itself now. Marketplace lays its page out again a few times while it loads after a swipe from Home, and the bars used to give up on it until Facebook restarted. They wait a few seconds and try again instead. (#468)

- With `Rounded tab bar` on and a tab bar that doesn't slide away, the space beside the pill shows the page again instead of a white or light grey block, and the Reels tab is black around it. That happened with `Keep the tab bar on screen` on, or on accounts where Facebook keeps the bar in place, because pages there stop above the bar in a different way. (#471)

- With `Keep the progress bar` on, reels you swipe to from a feed video's full-screen player keep the bar at the bottom again. It used to sit on top of the caption there, raised for a tab bar that the player covers. (#469)

- `Hide song and effect credits` takes the song pill with its "Try it" button off the story itself now, under the poster's name. Before, it only emptied the list that opens when you tap that pill, so the pill stayed. Effect credits on that row go too. (#380)

- With `Open feed videos on their own` on, a feed video you open plays by itself again. Every so often one more video slipped in after it, because the first batch Facebook loaded for the viewer came in with the next video already in it. That batch keeps only the video you tapped now. (#457)

- A reel opened from a chat inside Facebook stays on its own with `Open feed videos on their own` on. One more reel used to play after it before the viewer stopped. (#421)

- With `Hide the status bar` on, opening a reel's comments no longer pushes the reel down, and closing them no longer leaves a black band above the Reels header for a moment. The comments bring the status bar back while they're open, and Facebook used to make room for it under them too. (#456)

- Marketplace's home feed holds back the ad rows Facebook started sending from a new kind of request, so `Hide sponsored Marketplace listings` catches them again. (#459)

- `Hide For you in search` and `Hide "People you may know" in search` also find those sections when Facebook sends them with nothing Hush could read before. With `Debug logging` on, the report lists the section names each such row carries. (#80)

- With `See-through bars` and `Hold a feed video for 2x` both on, holding a button on the Reels tab works again. Download, Like and More used to speed the reel up instead of doing their own hold, because the Reels tab looked like a feed once its pages ran under the tab bar. (#449)

- With either `Clean up Reels` switch on, the Clean mode button over a clean reel sits higher now, clear of the seek bar. A tap meant for it used to land on the bar and jump the video. (#391)

- With `Keep feed videos muted` on, a video you unmuted goes quiet again when you leave Facebook and come back. The sound used to stay on until Facebook was force stopped or left alone for a long time. A video playing in the background keeps its sound, and turning the phone's screen off and on doesn't count as leaving. (#465)

- With `Hide comment and reaction previews` on, a reel's caption stays put. A few seconds in, Facebook used to swap it for a "Name commented: ..." line. (#464)

- On accounts where Facebook puts the tab bar at the top by itself, the Reels tab no longer leaves a black strip under the tabs once you scroll, when Reels isn't the first tab. The reel runs right up to the tabs, the way it already did with `Put the tab bar at the top` on. (#390)

- With the tab bar at the top, the Reels tab's title, search and profile buttons now sit below the tabs instead of behind them. The reel itself still runs up under the bar. (#390)

- The News feed switches of `Show full post text`, `Translate posts`, `Open comments with a gesture`, `See who shared` and `Photo carousel` show up even when that's the only feed patch you picked. The page used to open only for a set list of patches, and those five weren't on it.

- `Hide Back on opened videos` now also works on a reel or video you open from search results, including the screen with "Find related reels" across its top. Before, the arrow stayed there. That header isn't marked like the Reels tab's, so it's now found by its shape, and the search results page keeps its own Back. (#388)

- `Photo carousel` lets you swipe through every photo a post brought now. Facebook's row stopped at its own limit, 12 for some accounts, so a 76-photo album ended there while tapping into the post showed all 76. (#484)

- Dragging the seek bar on a live video you opened from search results moves the video now, in the reel-style viewer and in full screen. Facebook only seeks a live video once it's marked as behind live, which its full player does while you drag but those viewers never did. Search even opens some lives as if they weren't live at all, and those now land where you let go too. Let go at the far right end and it goes back to live. (#482)

- Tapping a Threads post in your feed opens that post in Threads now, not the Threads home feed. (#385)

- `Local profile counts` changes the numbers on your profile now. Facebook draws a count and its word as two separate pieces, and the switch only looked for them together. (#488)

- `Hide the 2x popups` also hides the "2x speed" chip on feed videos for accounts where Facebook has its own hold for 2x. Holding a video there still plays it at 2x, it just doesn't put the chip over it anymore. (#343)

- With `Tap to play` on, a video you send to the picture-in-picture window with the `Picture-in-picture button` plays there again. The window used to show a frozen picture, and its play and pause did nothing. Leaving Facebook with Home already worked. (#495)

- `Hide Threads cards between reels` and `Hide post cards between reels` keep those cards off the Reels tab again. On 587 the tab loads some of its reels another way, and those went straight onto the screen past every Reels filter, so a Threads card could still show up with the switch on. `Hide sponsored reels`, `Hide AI-detected reels and videos` and `Only reels from accounts I follow` cover that way in now too. (#85, #441)

- With `Debug logging` on, the log stops repeating where the tab bar goes and that a reel runs under the top bars on every layout of the screen. Each shows once when it changes now. In one report those two lines made up nine tenths of the log and pushed out the lines that help.

Other changes

- Hushfacebook now patches Facebook 587.0.0.39.55 and no longer takes 586. On a 64-bit phone download the (arm64-v8a) (240-640dpi) (Android 11+) bundle, build 707414333, and on a 32-bit phone the (arm-v7a) (320dpi) (Android 11+) bundle, build 707414338. Facebook didn't put out a 120-640dpi build of 587, so the 240-640dpi one is the 64-bit download now. Update Facebook before you patch.

- You need Morphe Manager 2.6.0 or newer for the next release. The patches are built on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, the one Manager 2.6.0 comes with, and an older Manager won't load them. Update Manager first. On a computer, use morphe-desktop 2.2.0 or newer.

- `Tab bar height` goes up to 130 now. Past 100 the pill gets taller instead of shorter. There's barely any room above the icons, so most of the extra height goes toward the bottom of the screen. (#425)

- `Hide posts with words you choose` and `Hide link posts` work on profiles, Pages, in groups and on the Reels tab too. Group posts go in a group's own feed and in the Groups tab's feed, while search results and a post you open stay as they are. A post or reel with one of your words goes, and so does one whose words send you to a website, like the "Watch More: https://..." drama reels. Words that keep a post keep these too, and a link to Facebook itself doesn't count. (#458)

- `See-through bars` makes its frosted copy of the screen at a quarter of the size, blurs that and stretches it back over the bar. The blur takes out the fine detail anyway, so it looks the same, and phones with a weaker graphics chip have a sixteenth of the pixels to blur on every frame. (#461)

- The Playback speed row that `Playback speed in the post menu` adds now sits on the menu's first page, with Save and Report, so it's one tap away. Before, it was under More options. Turn off `Playback speed on the menu's first page` to put it back there. (#473)

- `Double tap to skip on feed videos` shows how far you jumped, +10s on the right or -10s on the left, over the side you tapped. Keep tapping and it counts up, +20s, +30s, then fades out a moment after the last tap. (#432)

- In Morphe Manager's grouped patch list, `Block promotional notifications` now sits with the ad patches, so the Interface group stays short enough to scan.

- `Hide the Follow and Subscribe links on posts` is two switches now, `Hide the Follow link on posts` and `Hide the Subscribe link on posts` under News feed, so you can keep one and drop the other. The Subscribe one covers the link next to a creator's name on posts and videos. With only the Subscribe one on, a creator's header no longer swaps its Subscribe link for a Follow one. If you had the old switch on, both start on for you, and a settings file saved before the split turns both on too. (#434)

- `Play saved videos in a row` handles the swipe itself now. Before, Facebook's swipe showed a suggested reel for a moment, then the Saved page, before your next saved video came up. Now the video slides off under your finger and the screen stays black until the next saved one opens. Swipe down to go back to the one before. A short or slow drag slides back where it was, and a side swipe is still Facebook's. New `Stay on a saved video when it ends` under it keeps a finished video on screen until you swipe, off by default. (#404)

- With `Search date range` on, the Date posted picker opens on today for both ends, so today's posts are one tap on Apply away. A range you already applied still opens the way you left it. (#279)

- `Cast button on feed videos` also puts its button on a video you've opened in Facebook's full screen player now. It sits in the top right corner, just under Facebook's close button, and Facebook's own player controls stay as they are. (#182)

Behind the scenes

- `superpack-unpack.ps1 -Desktop` unpacks Facebook's Android 9+ build on a PC with no phone or emulator attached. (#102)

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.6.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `587.0.0.39.55`. On most phones that's build `707414333`, the arm64-v8a one. Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `707414338`, the armeabi-v7a one.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

What was checked

Local checks passed: 5682 tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 126 patches applied without forcing to Facebook 587.0.0.39.55, both the 64-bit and the 32-bit build, and a second build of the same commit matched this bundle entry for entry (1113 entries). I patched Facebook with this exact bundle and walked the whole app with every switch on, on a Samsung phone signed in to a full account. 88 of 127 hook families ran there, `Fold long text` and `Keep playing in the background` among them, all 23 settings pages opened in dark and in light, and Facebook didn't crash once. Android's verifier raised nothing on the patched build, the same as on Meta's own. The walk doesn't reach downloads, chats or the story viewer, so those are covered by the patch tests alone this time, and the 32-bit build was checked by its patch tests rather than on a device.

HushMessenger for Messenger 587.0.0.54.96, all 19 arm64 and armv7 builds, which needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. 98 patches. Calls can show live captions now, and unsent messages can stay in encrypted chats too. You can blur the chat list behind menus, send an Instant from your gallery, see when someone you track comes online and hide the Stories tab. Source updates don't change installed apps.

### New in this release

- `Hide Stories tab` is a new switch under Navigation. It takes the Stories tab out of the bottom bar after a restart, like the People and Notifications switches do. Refs #170.
- `Use the phone's camera app` has a new `Ask photo or video` option. The camera button asks which one you want and opens your camera app for it, so you can record videos too. Refs #168.
- `Mark as seen button` is a new switch under `View stories anonymously`. Stories you open get an eye with a slash through it while you're watching anonymously. Tap it and you show up in that story's viewer list, the way you would without the patch. The next story stays anonymous. Refs #169.
- `Send Instants from your gallery` is a new switch under Photos and videos. Tapping the shutter in Instants opens your gallery app, and the photo you pick goes out as the Instant, cut to the camera's shape. Back out of the gallery and nothing is sent. Refs #161.
- `Special contacts` is a new switch under Chat menu. Press and hold a chat with one person and tap Track this person. From then on HushMessenger writes down when they come online, go offline, type to you and change their name, using only what Messenger already shows you. Settings lists everyone you track with the last thing seen, their history, and buttons to clear it or stop tracking. You can track up to 50 people per account, and it all stays on this phone. It's experimental and starts off. Refs #163.
- `Blur behind menus` is a new switch under Theme. When you press and hold a chat, the chat list behind the menu blurs like it does on an iPhone, and so does the screen behind Messenger's other pop-up menus and sheets. It needs Android 12 or newer. Phones that can't blur behind a window (some Samsungs can't, and battery saver turns it off on others) get Messenger's own screen blurred under the menu instead. The `iPhone look` quick setup turns it on too. Experimental, and it starts off. Refs #162.
- `Live captions on calls` is a new switch under Calls. While you're on a call, what the other people say shows up as captions near the bottom of the screen, made by your phone's own speech recognition. Under the switch you pick the language they speak and the one you want to read, and if your phone can translate on the device the captions come out in your language. `Read captions aloud` reads each one in the phone's voice, and `Lower their voice while reading` turns them down while it does. It needs Android 13 or newer. It's experimental and starts off. Refs #159.
- `Row in the chat menu`, under `Keep a message log`, adds Message log to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat. Tap it and the log opens on just that chat's messages, and `All chats` takes you back to everything. It starts off. Refs #172.
- If `GmsCore support` is patched in but microG-RE isn't installed (or is turned off), the top of the HushMessenger settings says so now, since Messenger can't get notifications through Google's push service that way. `Copy setup` also gets a `Push:` line saying which push service Messenger is set up to use. Refs #173.
- The settings screen is in Turkish now. Refs #160.
- The settings screen is in Thai now, translated by MangaThatsFine. Refs #166.
- Switches that came with an update get a dot next to their name until you've seen their page, and so do their section and tab. TalkBack says "New" after the name. Refs #149.
- Material You gets a `Palette style` picker with the same choices as Android's wallpaper settings: Tonal spot, Neutral, Vibrant, Expressive, Rainbow, Fruit salad and Monochrome. A new `Light mode grays` switch tints Messenger's light-mode grays with your palette too, and white and black stay put. Refs #155.
- `Bigger chat preview` gives the preview most of the screen when you press and hold a chat, and you can scroll back through the chat right there. The menu under it stays short and scrolls. Refs #151.
- `Hide chat menu items` lets you pick what the press-and-hold menu on a chat shows. Press and hold any chat once and its items show up under the switch, ready to hide the ones you never use. Messenger always keeps at least one of its own. Refs #153.
- Two new switches under Navigation. `Hide the tab bar while scrolling` slides the bottom tab bar away as you scroll down your chats and brings it back when you scroll up. `Floating tab bar` turns on the floating style Messenger is trying out, which sits over your chats. Both take a Messenger restart. Refs #154.

### Fixes and changes

- The patches are built with Morphe patcher 2.3.0 now, the one that comes with Morphe Manager 2.5.0 and Morphe Desktop 2.1.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.5.0 or newer (or Desktop to 2.1.0) before you add this release.
- The patches now take Messenger 587.0.0.54.96 and drop 586. All 19 of 587's builds on APKMirror are covered. Refs #145.
- Videos in chat heads play like the rest of the chat now. On some phones Messenger 587 draws videos on a layer of their own, and a chat head could show that layer as a black box that stayed on screen after the chat head closed. In a chat head, or a bubble on Android 12 and newer, the video is drawn inside the chat instead. Videos in the app itself are unchanged. Refs #104.
- The switches for the menu you get when you press and hold a chat moved out of Inbox into their own Chat menu group, both in HushMessenger settings and in Morphe's patch list. Inbox had gotten long.
- The message log keeps up to 20,000 messages now, up from 5,000. Refs #172.
- `Keep unsent messages` works in encrypted chats too. When someone unsends a message there, it stays in the chat marked [unsent], as long as Messenger already showed you its words (in the chat or a notification) and hasn't restarted since. Refs #172.
- With `Spoof package version` on, parts of Messenger still saw the raised version number, like its background job check and its crash reports, because they get the app's version info in roundabout ways the patch didn't follow. Now every place Messenger reads a version number asks first whose it is. Messenger's own answers with the build you patched, and other apps keep the number Android gives. Refs #120.
- `Hide call buttons` and the call confirmation work again. Messenger 586 started wrapping a chat's audio and video call buttons in another button, and the patch was looking at the wrapper. Refs #146.
- `Ask before a call` asks on every call button now, including the ones outside a chat's top bar. A business chat and the New message screen build their own call buttons, so a tap there used to start the call right away. Refs #172.
- `Hide call buttons` takes the call buttons off business chats and the New message screen too. Those two screens build their own, so they used to stay. Refs #146, #172.
- On 586 a call crashed as it started when `Record calls` was on. The recording setup now takes its size from Messenger's own instead of 585's. Refs #146.
- The Experimental badge stays on one line. A long title used to squeeze it into a tall strip of one or two letters per line. Now it sits under the title when the two don't fit side by side. Refs #157.
- When a Meta-signed Messenger was uninstalled with its data kept, the install check told you to patch a higher version, which can't work for a build Meta signed. It points you at `Clone install` now, or at removing the leftover if you don't need its data. Refs #156.
- Patching goes faster. The code that finds where each patch goes had grown too big for Java to compile, so it ran slowly. It's split into smaller pieces now, and the slowest step takes about half as long on a computer. Refs #148, #150.
- `Android Auto messages` also works on accounts where Messenger leaves the car part out of its notifications. Messenger only adds it when a setting on Meta's side says so, and the switch turns that on. Refs #75.
- `Report a problem` reads Messenger's notification channels right again. Messenger 586 started adding a code to the end of each channel's name, so the report listed every one of them as unknown. Refs #158.
- A Root Mount over a different Messenger build now gets a warning instead of a mystery crash. Several builds share one version name, and mounting a patch made from one over another crashed chat heads. HushMessenger names the build Android has installed in a toast, under the name in settings and in `Copy setup`, so you know which one to patch. Refs #158.
- `Hide Your story when sharing` now also stops the "Chats or Your story" question some phones ask on every share. Xiaomi's share sheet groups an app's targets, and Messenger switched its story target back on at every launch, so you had to pick each time. With the switch on, sharing a photo goes straight to Chats. Refs #147.
- `Log chats that don't notify`, under `Keep a message log`, also saves messages from muted and restricted chats that aren't end-to-end encrypted, without a notification. Those chats used to stop before the log could see the message. Now they go through to the log and the notification is dropped right before it would show. Unsends still get marked, and auto reply leaves those chats alone. Refs #143.
- Patching in Morphe Manager holds less memory. One of the `Android Auto messages` lookups kept a copy of every APK it had read for as long as the patches stayed loaded, so patching a second time carried the first APK along. It lets go once it's done now. Refs #75.
- Patching does less work. The steps that look for chat heads, Material You colors and home screen shortcuts now skip code that can't match before reading it, and in testing on a computer a full patch used about a fifth less processor time. The patched app comes out exactly the same.
- Patching is quicker again. The step that finds where each switch goes used to read through Messenger's code once per switch, and now it reads it once for all of them. In testing on a computer a full patch took a little over half the processor time it did before, and the patched app is byte for byte the same.
- `GmsCore support` only tells Messenger that Google Play services is there while microG-RE is installed and turned on. It used to say yes either way, so without microG-RE Messenger kept reaching for an app that wasn't there. Now it carries on the way it does on a phone with no Play services. On Android 14 and newer, a phone without microG-RE also keeps Android's own sign-in route, so a password manager can still offer a saved login.
- A chat pinned with `Pin more chats` loses its pin mark as soon as you unpin it. The mark used to stay on the chat until Messenger restarted, even though Unpin had worked. Refs #56.

### How to update

1. Update Messenger to 587.0.0.54.96 first. On [APKMirror's 587.0.0.54.96 page](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-587-0-0-54-96-release/), take a build whose version code is 347415262, 347415267, 347415268, 347415280, 347415281, 347415284, 347415285, 347415295, 347415299, 347415301, 347415302, 347415333, 347415337, 347415348, 347415350, 347415351, 347415352, 347415354 or 347415355. APKMirror shows the code for each download, and a build posted there after this release may not be supported yet.
2. In Morphe Manager (2.5.0 or newer), open **Sources** and refresh HushMessenger. The card should say **98 patches**.
3. Patch Messenger again and install it over your current one. Your settings carry over.

Patching on a computer? `patches-0.30.0.mpp` below is the same bundle for Morphe Desktop 2.1.0 or newer. It's a patch bundle, not a Messenger APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` and its signature let you check the download, and the README says how.

### What was checked

- The full test suite, plus a patch run against all 19 Messenger 587.0.0.54.96 builds on file.
- Morphe Desktop patched and rebuilt one APK from each of the 4 build families.
- An APK patched from this exact bundle was installed on an emulator on Android API 32, signed in to Messenger. A chat, the inbox, both HushMessenger settings tabs, the message log, auto reply, Messenger's own settings, story settings and contact settings all opened, with no crashes.

Behind the scenes

- `scripts/gen-readme-patches.py` writes the README's patch table and counts from `patches-list.json` and leaves the rest of the README alone.

- The release walk now reads the settings overview while its own header shows HushGram's name, Home's welcome screen on 454, a long reel with its scrubber, and a screen with the activity tooltip up.

- `patch-all-builds.ps1` merges a split bundle before patching it, like the other patching scripts.

- The release facts check reads the patch count and target build from the description's sentences, so a change's bullet that counts patches no longer stops a release.

- Morphe Desktop 2.1.1 now has its reviewed advisory exceptions, so the audit accepts it.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.5.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `454.0.0.54.77`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

What was checked

The bundle patched Instagram 454.0.0.54.77 cleanly, and the whole app was walked on a Galaxy S22 with every screen opened and no crash.

## [1.6.4](https://github.com/RookieEnough/De-Vanced/compare/v1.6.3...v1.6.4) (2026-11-04)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Messenger:** Add support for `586.0.0.55.92` ([#177](https://github.com/RookieEnough/De-Vanced/issues/177)) ([17584e2](https://github.com/RookieEnough/De-Vanced/commit/17584e2903e907c1d63b408cbf4201fc7b76a8e0))
* **Strava:** Fix `Overwrite media upload parameters` patch ([7c7a9af](https://github.com/RookieEnough/De-Vanced/commit/7c7a9af6e39c6ea892d4883151e2ddefe52376cc))

This one moves to Facebook 586.0.0.52.53 and needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer, so grab the new Facebook APK before you repatch. There's a lot new. Reel saves can go into a queue and ask which quality you want, and a tap on Like can ask first so nothing gets liked by accident. Feed videos get double tap to skip and speeds up to 3x. `Only friends' posts` and `Hide all group posts` trim the feed way down, and `Open chats in Messenger` hands your chats to the Messenger app. There's also a new `Clone install under another package name` patch for phones where Facebook came preinstalled. On the fix side, you can sign in with your email and password again on a phone without microG-RE, and closing a post's comments keeps your place in the feed.

New in this release

- `Queue reel saves` under Reels and Watch makes a reel's Download button add the reel to a queue instead of saving it right away. Tap Download on as many reels as you like and they save one at a time in the background, each at the quality picked on its tap. A notification and Downloads in the settings count what's saved, waiting and failed, with Pause and Cancel. A reel already in the queue is skipped, and one that fails gets one more try. The queue lasts until Facebook closes. It starts off. (#449)

- `Hide Reply on comments` under Comments and writing takes Reply off the row under each comment. View replies stays, and so do Like and the reaction count. It starts off. (#447)

- `Choose quality on each save` under Downloads makes a reel's Download button and a video's Download to phone ask which quality to save first. Pick one and that save uses it, while `Download quality` keeps its value for every other save. Cancel saves nothing. It starts off. (#448)

- `Hide Create story` under Stories takes the Create story tile off the start of the Stories tray on Home. Everyone's stories stay where they were. It applies the next time Facebook loads the tray and starts off. (#445)

- `Hide Your shortcuts` under Menu takes the Your shortcuts row out of Facebook's Menu, so the groups and Pages Facebook keeps putting back there are gone in one go. The Menu tiles under it stay. Restart Facebook after turning it on. Starts off. (#445)

- `Saved button in search` under Search puts a bookmark at the end of the search bar. Tap it and Saved opens, so your saved posts and videos are one tap away. Marketplace's search bar gets one too. Restart Facebook after turning it on. Starts off. (#433)

- `Ask before liking a post`, `Ask before liking a reel` and `Ask before liking a comment` make a tap on Like ask "Like or unlike this post?" first. Continue likes or unlikes it, and Cancel or Back leaves it alone, so a stray tap doesn't. The post switch sits under News feed, the reel one under Reels and Watch and the comment one under Comments and writing. All three start off. (#437, #443)

- `Double tap to skip on feed videos` under Video and audio jumps a playing feed video 10 seconds ahead when you double tap its right side, or 10 back on the left. Keep tapping to go further. Live videos work too when they can be rewound. One tap on a side still opens the video, just a moment later than usual. With Tap to play on, it needs `Inline feed video controls` on too. Starts off. (#432)

- `Seek bar on the bottom edge` under Video and audio puts a feed video's seek bar right on the video's bottom edge, so a scroll is less likely to catch it. Facebook's speaker and tagged people buttons move up to sit above the bar. It wins over `Lower the seek bar and speaker`, needs `Seek bar on feed videos` and starts off. (#431)

Fixes

- With `Hide the Messenger count` on, TalkBack doesn't read the unread count anymore either. Facebook words the Messenger button's spoken label from the same number the badge shows, so a screen reader still said "15 unread messages" after the badge was gone. (#181)

- `Hide the Messenger count` also covers the top bar Facebook builds a different way on some accounts. That bar reads the count on its own, and its badge looks the count up again by itself, so neither the badge nor the spoken label went through the switch. Checked in tests, not yet on a phone. (#181)

- A site on the `Hide posts from people, Pages and sites` list now also hides links to it that Facebook opens in the site's own app, like a YouTube video or an Instagram post. Facebook hands those links over in a wrapper of its own, so youtube.com never matched them.

- `Pinch to zoom` on a story now zooms the story when your fingers start near its left or right edge. On some screens it zoomed only the narrow strip Facebook keeps there for tapping to the next or previous story. (#220)

- A zoomed story keeps the brightness of the story itself on Android 14 and newer. Facebook shows HDR stories brighter than normal white, and the zoom used to stop at normal white, so it looked dimmer than the story under it. (#220)

- The theme patches now also recolor what Facebook looks up through a second color path, which some of its newer text boxes use. Those colors went out untouched before, so in light mode `Material You theme` could leave them Facebook's gray. (#141)

- In light mode, `Material You theme` also reaches the light grays Facebook paints behind fields and boxes without naming a color for them, on sheets that slide up like the comments, on its server-built screens and in the boxes those screens draw, like the search field at the top of Settings. They stayed Facebook's gray before. White and text keep their colors, and with Debug logging on the log says where a gray it still leaves came from, down to the part of Facebook that asked for it. (#141)

- With `See-through bars` on in light mode, the top bar on Home no longer sits on a flat gray strip that ignored `Material You theme`. The page behind it was Facebook's own gray, and now it takes your wallpaper's colors like the rest of the page. (#141)

- `Local profile counts` now shows the numbers you typed on your own profile. It couldn't tell the profile was yours, so Facebook's real numbers stayed put. Other people's profiles still keep theirs. (#280)

- With `Keep the name and buttons while seeking` on, the preview frame and time that pop up while you drag a reel's progress bar now sit above the reel's name and caption instead of on top of them.

- With `Hide seen stories` on, the story you're watching stays in the tray until you close the viewer, and it leaves the tray after that. Watching it marked it seen right away, so the tray could drop it while it was still playing, which can send the viewer on to the next person's story after a moment. Stories you'd already seen before opening the viewer still stay out. (#438)

- With `Keep Settings and privacy expanded` on, tapping the Settings and privacy header in the Menu no longer flips its arrow down. The rows already stayed open, but the header still turned to "Section is collapsed" on the first tap. Now it stays expanded however many times you tap it. (#224)

- Pulling down the "Saving a video" notification now shows the download's speed and time. The card stopped after the size line ("31 MB of 176 MB…"), so the speed only ever showed in the Downloads list.

- A video saved with its sound as a separate track counts the sound from the first moment, so its progress bar no longer slips back when the sound starts downloading. On a 78 minute live replay it fell from 83% to 78%, and the size jumped from 137 MB to 174 MB.

- A video save no longer grabs a small file because its link happens to hold letters and digits that look like a size. An older video saved its 400x224 file instead of the 720p one when the smaller file's link read "3573p" somewhere in the middle, and `Convert to keep the full size` never got a turn. (#189)

- A video whose DASH file is over 512 MB, like a long live replay, falls back to Facebook's single file, and the message at the end now says so with the quality you got ("Saved to Movies/Facebook at 360p, since the bigger file is over 512 MB"). It used to say only that the video was saved in lower quality than on Facebook. That quality, here and for any save that steps down to a smaller file, is read from the saved file itself, since Facebook's link to a 360p file can just say "sd". (#238)

- The verdict under the word lists' test box is only rewritten when it changes. Every pause in typing used to set the same line again, and since TalkBack speaks that line whenever it's set, it could read the same verdict out after each pause.

- The play button from `Inline feed video controls`, and the buttons next to it, stay on the video when Facebook crops an upright video to fit a shorter spot in the feed. On a post like that they used to sit above the video, over the post's text. (#239)

- With `Long press opens comments` on, holding a post's profile picture on Facebook 586 opened the post's comments. Holding it now opens the profile when you let go, as it does with the switch off, and the post's menu button works the same way. Holding the photo or the name line still opens comments. (#179)

- After you tap Pause and before Facebook restarts, the card at the top of the Hush settings says "Hushfacebook is on" over "Hushfacebook pauses when Facebook restarts." It used to show that second sentence twice, as the title and again under it.

- `Hide posts from Pages` and `Only friends' posts` catch Pages again on Facebook 586. That version labels almost every post's author as a person, the Pages behind sponsored posts included, so Pages got past both switches. Hush now spots a Page by what Facebook says about it instead: no gender, no friend requests, and a follow button. Posts in groups still stay with `Hide posts from Pages` on, whoever wrote them. (#262)

- On Facebook 586, a page with Facebook's newer top bar could close the app. The hook behind the top bar's search button read the bar from a spot 586 reuses for something else, and Android then refused to load the bar at all. It now takes the bar from Facebook's own code right next to it.

While the logo and search box still showed at the top, the list ran past the bottom of the screen, so a section opened down there put all its rows out of sight and looked like the tap hadn't worked.

- With `Show the post date on reels` on and `How long ago` picked, every reel's date reads like "3 weeks ago" now. Other changes

- `Stop link history in Facebook's browser` also stops the analytics events Facebook's browser sends about the pages you open in it, like where you landed and how far you scrolled, login and payment forms it spots, checkouts, and the ad pixels and product data on a page. Pages load and work the same, and so does the rest of the browser.

- `Stop link history in Facebook's browser` also stops what the browser logs for ads. That's the attention events it records while a page is open, and an ad's call button being shown and tapped, along with the ad's and Page's ids and tracking codes. It fires on ordinary links too (two of these were held just opening one). That part of the browser only logs, so nothing about the page or the call button changes.

- `Stop link history in Facebook's browser` also stops the page reports Facebook's browser sends to its ad integrity checks. They carry the chain of addresses a link went through, each one's domain, the page's images and a fingerprint of its text and layout, plus tracking codes. Autofill, page translation and logging in with Facebook on a page go through the same part of the browser, and they work as before.

- The README's Help has a section for a sign-in that keeps going back to verification. Two people stuck that way got in after removing their account's passkey on facebook.com, which makes Facebook ask for approval from another device instead. (#273)

A window wider than tall would turn Facebook's screen sideways, which brought its video player up behind the window with a spinner, so a wide reel gets a square one. Wide reels get the Picture-in-picture row in their More menu too, and tall reels keep their tall window. (#418)

- `Photo carousel`'s dots stay put at the bottom middle of the row now, and only the blue one moves as you swipe. They used to slide along with the photo, which made them hard to follow. The count at the photo's top right still moves with it. (#442)

- `Save GIF`, `Save photo` and `Save video` on a comment's long press menu close the menu once you tap them, like Facebook's own rows do. The save still starts, and before you had to press Back to get the menu out of the way. (#440)

Behind the scenes

- `scripts/superpack-unpack.ps1` turns Facebook's Android 9+ build into one the patcher can read. That build keeps most of its code in a compressed store, which the script decodes on a connected phone with Facebook's own decoder. Every decoded file has to match the SHA-1 the build lists, and what comes out is an APK or bundle laid out like the Android 11+ build. It's the first step toward patching the Android 9+ build. (#102)

- Hush's own code now runs on Android 9 and 10, the next step toward that build. Anything that needs Android 10 or 11 checks first and does what the phone allows. On Android 9 a save goes straight into its folder, which takes storage access, so the first save asks for it and the next one goes through. `Lock Facebook` needs Android 10 or newer, and below Android 11 the accent and AMOLED colors cover a bit less of Facebook. Android 11 and newer work just as before. (#102)

- `Hide the speaker button on reels` finds the speaker on the Android 9+ build too. That build puts the button together right inside the reel controls instead of handing it to a builder, so with the switch on the patch skips just that part of the controls. Before, the whole Clean up Reels patch stopped on that build. `Move the speaker above the three dots` patches that build too. It reads Facebook's choice of button layout in the side column's render, where that build makes it, and not only in the side column's builder. (#102)

- Hush Unpacker (`helper/`) does what `scripts/superpack-unpack.ps1` does, right on the phone, with no computer. Pick the Facebook APK or .apkm made for Android 9 and 10. It decodes the store with that build's own library and checks every file against the build's list, then hands the copy to Morphe Manager or saves it where you choose. Its copy of 586 matches the script's byte for byte. Manager only takes a shared APK in Expert mode, so without it, save the copy and pick it under Other apps in Manager. Manager lists the Android 11 build for Facebook, so it warns about the version there, and you can go on past that. Releases attach the app as `hush-unpacker-<version>.apk`, signed and listed in `SHA256SUMS.txt`. (#102)

- The build runs on Morphe's patches Gradle plugin 2.1.0. It brings the Kotlin Gradle plugin 2.4.21 itself, so the build stopped forcing that version over the 2.4.10 the old plugin asked for.

- The build can sign a bundle with a MorpheSig1 signature, the kind Manager 2.3.0 and newer check, once a signing key is set up for it. The release index then publishes the matching public key, though only when the bundle it points at was signed with it, and never a key that differs from one it already published. The build refuses a bundle signed by any other key. Nothing is signed yet.

- The device walk taps the search field before it presses Enter. About 2 times in 10, Enter right after typing the search word went to the first suggestion under the field and searched nothing. The tap only goes to the one search field holding that word, once per search, and is refused anywhere else. Checked in the audit's tests.

- A post that shows its whole text from the start now counts as a `Show full post text` run in the hook status, and so does a reel caption that opens whole. With the switch on, Facebook never cuts the post, so the only count it used to get came from the cutter and the device walk read the switch as idle. The walk requires it again.

- The device walk won't tap a `Comment` button that's scrolled under the top bar, a header row or the tab bar anymore. A tap there lands on whatever covers the button, so on the all-on feed it opened the drawer instead of a comment sheet. The walk now takes the next `Comment` it can actually reach, or scrolls on.

- The device walk goes through Facebook's own Settings page and into its Notifications row. It doesn't look for a Feeds row in the Menu anymore, since Facebook 586 has none and no link from outside the app opens that page.

- `Keep the reel speed` goes in whole on Facebook's Android 9+ build. Two of its parts found nothing there and were left out with a warning: the gear menu's speed sheet ticking the speed a video really plays at, and `Speed on finished live videos`. That build finds the player in two steps and reads one of the gear menu's labels from a table of strings, and the patch now follows both. (#102)

- `Clean up Reels` goes in on Facebook's Android 9+ build too. The patch stopped there because it couldn't find the two rows that put a Subscribe button beside a video's author. On that build they read the button's name from a table of strings instead of holding it, and the button takes one of two paths to its place, so the patch now looks in those tables and follows both paths. (#102)

- `Open comments at full height` goes in on Facebook's Android 9+ build too. It stopped there because it found only one of the three places a reel opens its comments beside the video. On that build the other two read the reel footer's name from a table of strings, and the patch now looks there as well. (#102)

- `Show full post text` and `Translate posts` go in on Facebook's Android 9+ build too. Both stopped at the same check. That build reuses the register holding the post's story once the text is cut, and the patch took any later write as the story going missing. It now looks only at the writes that can reach the cut. (#102)

- `Tab bar at the bottom` and the top bar switches that come with it, `Hide the search button` among them, go in on Facebook's Android 9+ build too. The patch checks that Home names its top bar before it builds the bar's buttons, and on that build the bar builds them two calls further in, so the patch didn't see the build at all. It now follows the bar's own calls down to the search button. (#102)

- `Keep the progress bar` goes in on Facebook's Android 9+ build too. Before a reel's bar takes a new look, Facebook checks whether the bar already has it, and on that build the look is read through a small helper instead of right there. The patch now reads it through the helper as well. (#102)

- `Hide Menu promotions` and `Hushfacebook in the Menu` go in on Facebook's Android 9+ build too. On that build the Menu's Settings and Help lists are made and kept inside the small method the Menu asks for them, not in the Menu section itself, so neither patch found them. Both now look in that method as well. (#102)

- `Hide story rings` goes in on Facebook's Android 9+ build too. That build copies the part of the comment row that names the story ring into a second place, a prefetch step, and the patch stopped when it found two of them. Both ask the same helper for the ring, which is the one the patch changes, so it now takes two places that share their helper. (#102)

- `Hide suggested and promoted posts` keeps the search screen loading on Facebook's Android 9+ build when every row in its list is hidden. That build draws the list from a static method that the section's own method calls, and the patch only looked at the others. It looks at static methods too now. (#102)

- The `Save GIF` row from `Download any photo` and the `Save video` row from `Download any video` go in on a comment's long press menu on Facebook's Android 9+ build too. That build reuses the register holding the comment before the menu adds its rows, so the patch found no comment to hand over. It now reads the comment again through the same two fields the menu first read it from. (#102)

- `Hide Up next on videos` takes away the empty space Facebook keeps for that bar on its Android 9+ build too (#375). That build has no separate method that saves the space. It's saved inside the feed video's own code, so the patch now skips it there, the same way Facebook does when the space is already set. (#102)

- `Default comment order` goes in on Facebook's Android 9+ build too. On that build the comment sheet and the post page read the names of their request's settings from a table of strings, so the patch found neither request. It now looks in those tables as well. (#102)

- `Photo carousel` goes in on Facebook's Android 9+ build too. That build reads the swipeable photo's name from a table of strings, and the patch now looks there as well. (#102)

- The `Restore feed sound after opened videos` switch from `Keep feed videos muted` works on Facebook's Android 9+ build too. When an opened video closes, that build reads the name of the step that can turn the feed's sound on from a table of strings, so the patch left the switch out with a warning. It looks in that table now. (#102)

- `Hide Menu promotions` reaches the side Menu panel on Facebook's Android 9+ build too. That build sets the panel up in a second, private method and reads the panel's key from a table of strings, and the patch now follows both. There the small method that makes the Menu's Settings and Help lists also checks its two arguments first, which `Hide Menu promotions` and `Hushfacebook in the Menu` now read past. (#102)

- `Hide the 2x popups` from `Hold a reel for 2x` hides the feed video tip on Facebook's Android 9+ build too. That build has no separate method that decides whether to show the tip. The check is folded into the code that shows it, so the patch now changes the flag read right there. (#102)

- The fix that keeps Home from loading posts without showing any, after a screen reader or another accessibility service turns on or off, goes in on Facebook's Android 9+ build too. That build checks each row's layout in a small helper, and the patch now looks there. (#102)

- A device walk can pass on a phone whose Hushfacebook settings were left in list view. While the walk's audit folder is there, the settings open by category, so each page jump lands on its own page. Your list view comes back once the walk's restore removes the folder.

- The device walk stops closing the reel viewer after its long press. When nothing opened under the hold, the walk still pressed Back if the screen showed no video controls, and on a reel page that never loaded that Back closed the viewer, so the next reel check failed. Now a screen that reads the same after the hold as before it gets no Back. A reel check that fails also saves the windows and the screen it found to the walk's folder.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.5.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `586.0.0.52.53`. On most phones that's build `476217123`, the arm64-v8a one. Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `476217122`, the armeabi-v7a one.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

What was checked

Local checks passed: 5328 tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 122 patches applied without forcing to Facebook 586.0.0.52.53, both the 64-bit and the 32-bit build, and a second build of the same commit matched this bundle entry for entry (1046 entries). I patched Facebook with this exact bundle and walked the whole app with every switch on, on a Samsung phone signed in to a full account. 86 of 123 hook families ran there, `Hold a reel for 2x`, `Saved button in search` and `Hide story rings` among them, all 23 settings pages opened in dark and in light, and Facebook didn't crash once. Android's verifier raised nothing on the patched build, the same as on Meta's own. The walk doesn't reach downloads, chats or the story viewer, so those are covered by the patch tests alone this time, and the 32-bit build was checked by its patch tests rather than on a device.
