Instagram 454.0.0.54.77 is the build to patch now, and most of this release came straight from your reports. Reels get a speed button and a seek bar that stays put in clear mode, holding a post can open it full screen, and the glass tab bar blurs what's behind it far better than it did. The list of fixes below is a long one.

New in this release

- New `Blend post edges` switch under `Ambient light` fades a post's top and bottom into its glow, so the edge doesn't show as a hard line. Asked for in #510.

- `Story rings in the accent color` is a new switch under `Accent color`, off to start. Rings drop Instagram's gradient for your color after a restart. Asked for in #187.

- `Backgrounds in the accent color` is another new switch there. Screens, panels, cards and menus take a dark or light shade of your color, and it wins over `Pure black dark mode`. Asked for in #187 and #8.

- `Accent color` now reaches text that gets its blue from a layout, like the `Older posts` link. Reported in #187.

- `Add the source to saved photos` covers videos now and is called `Add the source to saved photos and videos`. A saved MP4 gets the poster, the post date and the post's link in tags exiftool and most galleries read.

- Tagging a saved video leaves its picture and sound exactly as they were. A video the save knows nothing about isn't touched.

- `Choose Seen in each chat` under Messages puts an eye next to a chat's call buttons. Tap it to hold Seen in just that chat, send it there, or go back to what `Read messages without the seen receipt` says. Asked for in #13.

- Picking a Seen choice for a chat doesn't send anything by itself, and the chat keeps its pick after a restart. A chat held that way still gets Mark as read in its long press menu and its preview.

- `Choose Seen in each chat` starts off. It needs `Lock your messages` patched in, which it is by default, since that's how HushGram knows which chat is open.

- `Show categories as a grid`, near the top of HushGram settings, turns each category into a tile with its icon, name and a line on what's in it. Tiles sit two across, three on a wide screen. Asked for in #494.

- Tap a category tile and it opens right below the tiles while any other one folds. It's all still one page, and the grid starts off.

- `Keep playing in the background` keeps a video or reel with sound going when you leave Instagram or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause or stop it. It's under Playback and starts off. Refs #497.

- `Hide reels in other languages`, under Reels next to `Hide reels by caption words`, hides reels whose caption is in a language you didn't list under `Languages to keep`. `Also on Home` applies it to Home's posts. It starts off. Refs #495.

- In `Languages to keep`, type codes or names like `en, Hindi, Español, fil`, or leave it empty to keep your phone's languages. A reel whose caption is too short to tell, or that the phone can't place, stays.

- `Hide the reply box on stories` is a new patch. With its switch on under Stories, the Send message box comes off the bottom of other people's stories, and the like and share buttons stay where they were. Starts off. Asked for in #486.

- `Full screen Reels and Home` adds `Stories fill the screen` under Stories. On a tall phone a story fills the whole screen like on shorter phones, instead of a rounded card that stops above the reply bar. Starts off. Asked for in #436.

- `Speed button on reels` adds an icon beside a reel with a short list of speeds, 0.5x to 3x. `Keep the reel speed` carries your pick to the next reels. Both are under Reels and start off. Asked for in #480.

- `Full screen button on reels` adds an icon beside a reel that does what Full screen in its menu does. Turn on `Start every reel in clear mode` to open every reel that way. Starts off, under Reels. Asked for in #480.

- `Stop Reels scrolling` has three new switches under it, so reels opened from a profile, Search and Explore or a song page can still scroll while the Reels tab stays stopped. They start off. Asked for in #508.

- `Always show seek bar in clear mode` under Reels keeps the seek bar on screen and draggable in clear mode while everything else stays hidden. Short reels get a bar too. Asked for in #480.

- `Show the Friends tab on Reels` adds the Friends tab to the top of the Reels tab on accounts that never got it. What's in it still comes from Instagram, so it can be empty. Asked for in #499.

- `Hold the Friends tab to pick friends` lets you hold the Friends tab on Reels, pick friends, and keep only the reels they liked or shared. Asked for in #503.

- `Hide the tab bar on Reels` works with Glass tab bar off now, so Instagram's own bar can slide away on Reels too after the wait you pick, and the reel takes its room. Asked for in #343.

- `Long press a post for full screen` under Feed opens a photo or video on black when you hold it, with a slider on videos. Starts off. Asked for in #505.

- `Don't vibrate in clear mode` under Reels stops the little buzz Instagram plays when a reel opens in clear mode. With `Keep clear mode on` you'd feel it on every swipe. It starts off and changes take effect right away. Asked for in #480.

- `Burn-in guard` dims stories now too. Leave a story untouched and its progress bar, name and buttons fade until your next tap. Typing a reply keeps them bright. `Dim stories too` under Reels turns this off. Asked for in #479.

- `Preview chats` is a new patch under Messages. Long press a chat and tap Preview to read it without sending Seen, and reply there. It has Mark as read when `Read messages without the seen receipt` is on. Starts off. Asked for in #477.

- `Phone layout on big screens` is a new patch under Layout. On a foldable's inner screen or a tablet it keeps Instagram's phone layout, with the tab bar along the bottom. Restart Instagram after flipping it. Starts off. Asked for in #478.

- `Hide activity bubbles` is a new patch. Turn it on under Feed and the little round pictures showing a friend liked, commented on or reshared a post or reel go away. Starts off. Asked for in #475.

- `Don't report Blend visits` is a new Ghost mode patch. With its switch on under Messages, opening a Blend from a chat doesn't post the "visited the Blend" line there. Ghost mode turns it on with the others. Starts off. Asked for in #474.

- `Page dots on a pill`, `Seek bar on feed videos` and `Seek bar on stories` can now look See-through or Frosted glass (Android 12 and up) as well as Solid. The pill no longer covers a carousel's seek bar. Asked for in #471.

- `Speed button on stories` is a new patch. Turn it on under Stories for a 1x button by a video story's three dots. Taps step through 1.5x, 2x and back to 1x, and later stories keep that speed. Starts off. Asked for in #469.

- `Read messages without the seen receipt` adds `Mark as read button in chats` under Messages. A check mark next to a chat's call buttons marks it Seen for the other person when you tap it. Starts on. Asked for in #458.

- `Swipe through a chat's reels` gets a child switch, `Only received reels`. With it on, swiping skips the reels you sent and goes through what the other person shared. The reel you tapped still opens. Starts off. Asked for in #460.

- `See who a story mentions` gets a child switch, `Red story mentions`. It draws the mention pill's text in Instagram's red instead of white, so it stands out on bright stories. Starts off. Asked for in #459.

- `See who a story mentions` adds `Where the mention pill goes`. Keep it under the story's name or move it to the top bar as `@2 mentions` or `@2`, where its list opens from the bottom of the screen. Asked for in #468.

- `Hide the audio icon on posts` is a new patch. Under Feed, it takes the speaker icon off videos in your feed, and tapping a video still turns the sound on or off. It starts off. Asked for in #464.

- `Change the like animation` adds `Grow the heart`. Double tap the same post again within a second and a half and the heart pops up a step bigger, up to 1.75 times. A pause starts it small again. Starts off. Asked for in #461.

- `Clean up Reels` gets `Light when paused`, under Burn-in guard. Pause a reel and the faded buttons come back to full brightness until you play it again or swipe on. The wait then starts over. It starts off. Asked for in #457.

- `HushGram settings` adds `Black settings page` under Settings entry. Cards and dialogs go black, HushGram's name and version sit at the top, and each category is one line with its icon. Starts on. Off brings back the charcoal page. Asked for in #455.

- `Home header text` is a new patch. Under Layout, type a few words or pick a picture and it shows at the top of Home where Instagram's logo was. Leave both empty to keep the logo. Asked for in #454.

- `Upload stories at full quality` adds `Upload quality applies to`, so posts and reels can go up at 1080p too, and `Video bitrate`, which asks for 12 to 50 Mbps. Instagram still re-encodes everything on its servers. Asked for in #37.

- `Start Home on Following` adds `Mix in Following` under Feed. For you shows a page of posts from accounts you follow after each page of its own, until you've seen them all. It starts off. Asked for in #438.

- `Glass in chats` is a new patch. Under Messages, one switch gives a chat's top bar frosted glass and puts the back, call and video buttons on round glass circles. It starts off. Asked for in #449.

- `Chat plus menu` is a new patch. Under Messages you can take Saved, AI images and Draw off a chat's plus menu, each with its own switch, and move the gallery and microphone buttons into it. All four start off. Asked for in #448.

- `Pick the app icon` gets a `Custom app icon` row under Layout. Pick a picture from your phone, drag and zoom it into the frame, and it's added to your home screen as an icon that opens Instagram. Asked for in #442.

- HushGram's settings now come in Vietnamese. Asked for in #439.

- `App icon` adds two more choices, Instagram's gradient glyph on dark and the old brown and cream camera icon. Themed icons show Instagram's glyph for both, since the camera's solid square would come out as a blank tile. Asked for in #327 and #437.

- `App icon` adds `Instagram in pink`, Instagram's glyph in a deep pink on pale pink. Themed icons show the usual glyph. Asked for in #470.

- `Menu button on Home's header` adds a button at the top of Home that opens your viewing history, Ghost mode and HushGram settings. It starts off. Asked for in #437.

- `Seek bar button on feed videos` adds a small button on a feed video that shows or hides its seek bar. It starts off. Asked for in #437.

- `Keep stories playing while zooming` is a new patch. With its switch on under Stories, a story keeps playing while you pinch to zoom it. Hold it still first and it stays paused. It starts off. Asked for in #382.

- `Skip the ad data reminder` is a new patch under Ads and privacy. Instagram's reminder to review how it uses your data for ads stops opening by itself. Your ad choice doesn't change. It starts off. Asked for in #331.

- `Stories priority` is a new patch. Type the accounts you care about under Stories, one to a line, and when one has a story you haven't watched it goes first in Home's stories row, in your order. Asked for in #451.

- `Hide reels with few views` is a new patch. Under Reels it leaves out reels under a view count you type (1,000 to start) or a like count (10). Instagram hides most view counts now, so likes matter more. Asked for in #444.

- `Hide Suggested for you on follow lists` now also takes the suggested people off the Follow requests screen. Your real requests stay. Asked for in #441.

- `Swipe through a chat's reels` adds `Messages after a reel`. When someone wrote after the reel you're on, a banner says so, and a tap takes you back to the chat at that message. Starts off. Asked for in #489.

- `Select text to copy` is a new switch under Comments. Comments get a Select text row in their menu, and captions and bios get one too, so you can copy just the part you want. Starts off. Asked for in #492.

- `Notify me of unfollowers` sits under Recent unfollowers and needs it on. Once you scroll your own Followers list to the end, a notification names whoever left since last time. It never checks in the background. Starts off. Asked for in #492.

- `Save profile picture` adds `About this account button`, an (i) next to a profile's three dots that opens Instagram's About this account page for it, since Instagram took its own button away. Starts off. Asked for in #492.

- `Ambient light` now reaches under the tab bar on the Reels tab, on Instagram's own bar and around a docked glass pill, so the glow doesn't stop at the bar. Asked for in #487.

- `Show a comment GIF's name` adds a row to a comment's menu with the name of its GIF or sticker, and a tap on it copies the name. Asked for in #502.

Fixes

- `Ambient light` no longer glows around photos and stickers in chats, or in the strip under the comment bar on a reel opened from the feed. Reported in #510.

- `Ambient light`'s glow now carries on under a post's rounded corners, which showed as dark wedges with `Rounded corners on posts` on. Reported in #510.

- The story mentions pill sits right under the name again, not a pill's height below it. Reported in #510.

- `Keep clear mode on` no longer brings the top bar back when you swipe to the next reel. Reported in #480.

- `Profile extras button` and `About this account button` no longer look the same side by side. The extras one is a circled arrow now.

- With `Add the source to saved photos and videos` on, a saved carousel page links the post it's from instead of a link that doesn't open. A saved story gets no link, since stories have no post page.

- With `Gallery and microphone in the plus menu` on, `Buttons in the message box` says those two are in the plus menu instead of calling them shown or left off. It updates the moment that switch flips.

- With `Name saves by account and post time` on, `Download file name` now says its names only go to saves that don't know who posted or when, and it updates as soon as that switch flips.

- With `Show if a profile follows you` off, the greyed `Follow label` row asks you to turn that on. It used to point at `Show it as a chip` even when the chip was already on.

- Five descriptions now say what their settings really do. `Locked chats` unlock the way `Unlock with` is set, which can be your own PIN or fingerprint only. `Keep a viewing history` notes who posted each item.

- `Open links in external browser`'s description says it keeps Facebook, Messenger and Threads links in the app too, along with Instagram's and ads.

- The download name and follower descriptions say photos get their usual name only when `Name saves by account and post time` doesn't rename them, and `Follower history` only logs with `Recent unfollowers` on.

- `Settings`: Cancelling a switch that asks before it changes now takes the turned-down value back out of storage too. Before, the row went back but the next start used the value you'd said no to.

- `Show it as a chip` stays greyed out while `Show if a profile follows you` is off, and so does the choice of where the chip goes. Neither did anything with the label off, though both looked ready.

- `Profile extras button` stays greyed out until `Save profile picture`, `View profile picture` or `Copy username and bio` is on. It used to look ready with all three off, though the button never showed up on profiles that way.

- `Convert to keep the full size` says HDR videos stay smaller too, as they always have. `Hold to download` mentions that `Fingers` right under it can make the hold three fingers instead of two.

- The description of `Seek bar like DM videos` calls `Bigger seek bar on reels` by its full name now, in every language, so you can find the row it means.

- Eleven translated descriptions pointed at another row in English or by a name that row doesn't show, like German's „Folge ich“ for the Following tab Instagram calls „Gefolgt“.

- German, Spanish, Indonesian, Italian, Korean, Portuguese, Turkish, Vietnamese and Chinese descriptions now call each row by its own title.

- Korean ran two sentences of the folder name help together, and Vietnamese left out that what you typed isn't a place.

- Korean's message after a restore no longer has grammar slips, and neither does its tip to use `폴더 선택` for a path or an SD card.

- Traditional Chinese now says 你 everywhere. It switched between 你 and 您 from one row to the next, so the chip on a profile said 你 while the switch that shows it said 您.

- In a right-to-left language, the settings title, the search hint and the text in HushGram's own dialogs (PIN, Details, story mentions) start on the right by their icon or title, even when the text is English.

- Patching again without `Chat plus menu` brings the gallery and microphone back to a chat's message box. With `Gallery and microphone in the plus menu` on, they used to vanish with no menu and no row to undo it.

- With `Pure black dark mode`, the comments sheet turns black as soon as Instagram finishes setting it up, however that set-up ends. Some endings skipped the paint, so the sheet waited for its comments screen to turn it black.

- Numbers on the sliders, the reel view and like limits, the upload bitrate choices and the story ring sizes are written in Instagram's language now, like the rest of HushGram's settings.

- With Instagram set to a language of its own, those numbers used to follow the phone's language, so an Arabic phone showed Arabic digits there and nowhere else.

- Exporting your HushGram settings over an older, longer backup file no longer leaves the old file's end behind it. A few file providers don't empty a file first, so that backup wouldn't import though the export said it worked.

- A settings export now reads the file back and trims it, and says so if it can't.

- On Android 9 and 10, TalkBack reads a HushGram slider's value the way the row shows it ("20 reels") instead of a percent of the bar.

- With `Ambient light` on, playing a video you sent from your gallery in a chat no longer crashes Instagram. The glow kept getting wrapped in a new layer every frame until memory ran out. Reported in #485.

- `Seek bar on stories` sits above a story's bottom row again. Instagram moved the Send message box, like and share into a new row, and the bar ended up drawn over them. Reported in #486.

- `Ambient light in stories` now glows under the status bar and the gesture bar too. Instagram's story viewer stops short of both, so the glow ended at its edges and the strips above and below a story stayed black. Reported in #487.

- With `Black settings page` on, the bar at the top of the main settings page no longer repeats HushGram's name over the centered header. Once the header scrolls away, or while you search, the bar names the page again.

- `Saved on your profile` no longer keeps every profile screen you've looked at in memory for as long as Instagram runs. The bookmark's row held on to the tabs it was keyed on.

- The settings page no longer waits on an import that's still running to find out whether Undo is on offer.

- `See who a story mentions` pauses the story while its list is open. A photo used to move on under it. Close or Back plays it on, and it stays paused while you visit a profile from the list. Reported in #403.

- Reels auto scroll now moves on right as a reel ends, not after the first second plays again. Instagram leaves that to a server setting, and `Keep Reels auto scroll on` now turns it on for every account. Reported in #473.

- `Seek bar on feed videos` no longer leaves a video stuck after a drag. The video pauses while your finger is on the bar and plays on from where you let go. Reported in #472.

- With `Glass tab bar` and `Hide the tab bar on Reels`, the reel stays put when the pill slides away or comes back. It runs behind the pill with its caption and buttons kept above it. Reported in #466 and #467.

- `See who a story mentions` opens its list again after a profile. That works when the next story mentions other people too, and on Instagram 453, where the profile opens over the story. Reported in #403.

- `See-through top bar` now reaches behind the status bar. Home's posts scroll on under the clock and the glass covers that strip too, so the blur runs to the top of the screen. Reported in #462.

- `Download button on feed posts` now says it needs `Download feed videos` or `Download feed photos`. The row stays grey until one of them is on, and nothing explained why. Reported in #465.

- `Turn off HDR brightness boosts` now also turns off the fake HDR that Instagram's own AV1 decoder can add to ordinary reels, which could still come out brighter than the rest of the screen. Reported in #85.

- `Logo and titles at the start` now moves the Messages title and the Reels tabs too. The Reels tabs sit right after Create, or off the edge when Create is hidden. Reported in #407.

- With `Stop after the chat's reels` on, a chat's reels scroll one after another again. A swipe past the last one goes back to the chat, and pulling down no longer loads suggested reels. Reported in #390.

- `Explore without personalization` did nothing outside the EU. It now asks for the grid that isn't personalized on every account, though Instagram only promises that grid in the EU. Reported in #311.

- `Rounded corners on Reels` rounded the screen's corners instead of the video's when a reel had black bars above and below it. The corners now go on the video and move with it. Reported in #456.

- `Jump to the first message` could stop partway up a long chat. On a slow connection it now waits for older messages and taps Instagram's Retry. A clock button by the call buttons opens its menu too. Reported in #453.

- A jump to a date in a chat now puts that day's first message at the top of the screen with its date above it. It used to land at the bottom, so the jump looked short. Reported in #246.

- The glass tab bar could stay over a story's reply box until Instagram restarted, when an older story viewer was still hidden in the background. The bar now looks past it. Reported in #450.

- Some videos showed sharp through the glass bars because Instagram played them on a second kind of video view. Glass, reel blur, ambient light and `Turn off HDR brightness boosts` now keep every video on the view they can read. Reported in #430.

- `Hide suggested searches on reels` and `Hide shopping buttons on reels` missed a few pills. Searches like "Purple dog booties" and the shop lens buttons now go too. Reported in #332.

- `Back leaves Home as it is` now also skips "Tap again to exit" and the feed reload at the top of Home, so one Back leaves from anywhere in the feed. Reported in #54.

- `Recent unfollowers` keeps your Followers list once it stays unchanged for a few seconds, so a half-loaded list can't pass for people leaving. A Follower history row logs who left or came back. Sent in by argus2968 in #309.

- With `Keep chats unread here` off, a chat you've already read here no longer opens with the New Messages line and jumps up to it. Nothing new is sent. Reported in #186.

- The `Install next to Instagram` copy no longer crashes on the language pack screen, and it carries on to Instagram once the pack has downloaded. Sent in by snowyegret23 in #392.

- Material You in `Accent color` could crash Instagram at launch when a wallpaper's color happened to match one of Instagram's blues. Reported in #435.

- `Keep a viewing history` now records posts on Home and in the post viewer, and the list has its own page: a tab for each kind, a search box, and a tap opens the post or person again. Reported in #228.

- `Profile extras button` shows up on profiles again, and `Keep a viewing history` records the profiles you open. Instagram 453 changed how both read the account. Reported in #234 and #482.

- The `Profile extras button` row says it needs `Save profile picture`, `View profile picture` or `Copy username and bio` on, since the button stays hidden without one of them.

- `Hide the caught up card` now also takes the "You've seen the latest posts" line off the top of Home. `Older posts` stays, so Home never ends up empty. Reported in #307.

- On some phones a tap on a reel's More button or audio square moved the reel instead of opening it. Instagram's seek bar strip covered them and now lets those taps through. Comes with `Keep a seek bar on Reels`. Reported in #452.

- A long press on a chat's name opens the menu for `Jump to the first message or a date` and `Export a chat as text` again. A plain tap still opens the details

- `Export a chat as text` now finds a chat's messages. It used to say there were none. Each message is now read from its own row, so an export holds only that chat

- `Export a chat as text` and `Jump to the first message` now load a long chat all the way back instead of stopping at the newest page. Shared reels and voice messages read as plain words

- `Ask before a call`, `Ask before a like` and `Ask before a refresh` no longer let some presses through unasked. A long press on a tab or on your profile's menu button got the same fix

- With `Carousel arrows` or `Page dots on a pill` on, the feed no longer stutters past carousel posts, and Instagram no longer freezes. Reported in #425 and #417.

- The time above a reel's seek bar no longer loses its top half with `Run Reels behind the tab bar` on

- `Save folder` no longer turns a typed path into a folder on internal storage. For an SD card it points you to `Choose a folder`, and once you've picked one it says `Save folder` isn't in use

- A reel opened from the feed or a profile no longer sits between black bands with `Hide the comment bar on all reels` or `Hide the comment bar on reposted reels` on. Square reels still fit

- Tapping a story sticker to edit it again now keeps the font you picked from your phone. With two or more of them, it used to switch to the first one

- With `Pure black dark mode`, the Likes list is black all the way down. Its rows stayed dark gray under a black header. A row still shows gray while you press it. Reported in #248

- With `Pure black dark mode`, new notifications are black too. Instagram tinted their rows gray in dark mode until you'd seen them, and that could cover half the page. Light mode keeps its blue. Reported in #374

- `Seek bar on stories` sits above the Activity, Share and Send row and the comment line on your own story, instead of on top of them. Reported in #490 and #492.

- `Full screen Reels and Home` lets Fill the screen use the whole width on a foldable's cover screen or any screen wider than a phone's, where it used to leave empty sides. Asked for in #491.

- `Swipe through a chat's reels` shows the reply bar past the first reel again. A reply or reaction quotes the reel on screen, not the one you tapped. Reported in #488.

- `Ambient light` lights the screen around story videos that Instagram plays on a SurfaceView. It used to light the picture behind them. Reported in #492.

- The Saved bookmark on your profile opens your saved posts through Instagram's own link, in any language. Before, it could open settings. Reported in #492.

- The `Blur the bars around Reels` summary says the blur only shows where a reel leaves room. The share sheet's button list says Reply to author is on posts and reels, and Download profile card on profiles. From #492.

- With `Gray out stories you've watched` on, a story you've watched all the way through keeps its place in the tray after a long watch too, until you pull to refresh or restart. Reported in #377.

- `Mark who doesn't follow you back` gives the mark a second line on your Following list, so the Message button can't cut it short. Reported in #351.

- A saved photo is now the largest size Instagram lists. A bigger size could lose to a smaller one because of how its address looked, and a report names every size listed. Reported in #500.

- `Download as photo` on a video story saves the video's first frame when Instagram's picture is smaller and the same shape, so 640x1136 becomes 1080x1920. Reported in #214.

- `About this account button` no longer shows an error on Pages. It told the screen it came from an ad, and now says it came from the profile, the way Instagram's own menu does. Reported in #507.

- `Keep Featured off the heart's dot` also covers other people's new posts and Instagram's own news, and counts that arrive with your inbox. Likes, comments, follows and follow requests still light the heart. Reported in #189.

- Turning off `Search button on Home's header` takes the magnifier away as soon as you close settings, not at the next restart. The header's other added buttons do the same. Reported in #492.

Other changes

- `Ambient light` works the phone less. It waits for a scrolling list to stop before reading a picture, and a still photo gets read less and less often. Reported in #510.

- The switches that work the phone hardest now say they can slow down older phones. Asked for in #510.

- `Start reels with sound` covers the Reels tab as well as a reel you open from a post on Home. Home is still muted again when you leave. Reported in #504.

- `Glass tab bar` blurs less to start with, so what passes under the pill shows as soft shapes instead of a flat dark tint. `Blur strength` starts at 8 dp now, and a value you already set stays. Reported in #289.

- With `Liquid glass look` on, the bubble on your tab springs into place when you switch tabs. Asked for in #289.

- `Mark as read button in chats` shows under Messages only when `Lock your messages` is patched in too, since the check mark finds the open chat through it.

- HushGram now patches Instagram 454.0.0.54.77 instead of 453.0.0.57.79. Get APKMirror's (arm64-v8a) (480dpi) (Android 9.0+) bundle, build 386014758. Its armeabi-v7a (386014757), x86 (386014759) and x86_64 (386014760) builds are declared too, and the other arm64 density builds patch cleanly.

- HushGram now builds on Morphe patcher 2.3.0, so patching needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. On a computer, use morphe-desktop 2.1.0 or newer.

- `Hide the Map bubble` is a new switch under Messages. It takes only the Map bubble out of the row of notes, and your notes stay. It starts off. Asked for in #432.

- `Glass tab bar` has a `Refraction intensity` slider for how hard the liquid pill bends what's behind its edge, and a preview that changes as you drag. The opacity slider is now `Tint intensity`. Asked for in #391.

- The `Glass tab bar` preview now draws its glass on black in the dark theme and on white in the light theme, like the real bar. It used to draw it on black in both. Follows #391.

- `Show and reorder tabs` works with a screen reader. Each tab's handle offers Move up and Move down, and TalkBack tells you where the tab landed. The first tab isn't offered Move up, nor the last Move down. Follows #207.

- A greyed-out slider now says which switch to turn on, in place of a value it can't change, the way the greyed-out choice rows already do.

- The line under a greyed-out setting is easier to read. It faded as much as the title did, and it's the line that tells you what to turn on first.

- `Report a problem` no longer leaves a stray question mark when it has to shorten a very long phone name with emoji in it.

- On a phone with no browser, `Report a problem`, `Source code and issues` and `Support HushGram` say so and then show their address in a second toast. With both in one toast, the end of the address got cut off.

- VP9 and AV1 reels whose only sound in the manifest is xHE-AAC now save at full quality. The join couldn't read the post's plain video file, where their sound comes from, so they fell back to the 720p copy. Refs #496.

- At the best download quality, a 60fps video now beats a 30fps one of the same size, even in another format. Reported in #348.

- `Import settings` lets you pick any file. A settings file from a chat or a download often carries some other type, and the picker used to grey it out. A file that isn't a settings file is still refused.

- In Morphe Manager's patch list, `Control taps and volume on Reels` now sits under Playback next to its switches, and `Hide rows in Instagram's settings` under Settings, so no group runs past 16 patches.

- The chat preview bubble, the story mentions sheet and its Close button use the same corners as the rest of HushGram. The friendship chip and the carousel arrows aren't round pills anymore.

- In a settings dialog, the picked choice keeps its tint inside the panel's corners, and pressing a choice that isn't picked shows the press. It didn't show at all before.

- The bar that shows up after you flip a switch that needs a restart now looks like something to tap, with a restart icon and a blue outline.

- Empty text fields show their placeholder in a softer color than saved text, so it doesn't read as something you typed. `Home header text` now says `Your words` until you type.

- Each row on the Layout page has an icon that fits it. `Import HushGram settings` shows a download arrow, and `Undo settings import` and `Viewing history` show the history clock.

- `Version` in About puts the build identity on its own line in a fixed-width font, so it's easier to read and copy.

- The last settings row stops above the gesture bar instead of sitting on it.

- The viewing history page follows `Black settings page`, its search box matches the one on the settings page, the picked tab is underlined, long names end in an ellipsis and an empty list shows an icon.

- `Show and reorder tabs` draws its drag handles instead of using a text symbol that changed with the phone's font.

- The main settings page no longer shows a thin grey line down each screen edge. The restart bar and the viewing history search now line up with the cards.

- About 60 of HushGram's toasts ran past the two lines Android shows, in English or a translation, so their ends never showed. They're shorter now in all ten languages.

- When safe mode pauses HushGram it says so in two toasts, and the second says where to turn it back on.

- `Pure black dark mode` and `Seek bar on stories` find their story code through the patcher's index instead of reading every class. With every patch on, patching takes about 4% less processor time. The patched app is the same. Refs #173.

Behind the scenes

- `patch-for-device.ps1` merges a split bundle before handing it to the CLI, so it works on a machine that refuses to follow the links the CLI makes.

- `preflight.ps1 -Version` now refuses a source census past its 14 days. Until now the index push was the first thing to say so, after the gate, the walk and the publish.

- `count_tests.py --description` prints only the validation sentence on stdout and its counts on stderr, so saving its output gives `release_notes.py` the one line it wants.

- When `verify-all-patches.ps1 -KeepIn` can't keep a passing run, it now deletes only the files the keep writes. It used to delete the whole folder you named, with everything else in it.

- A `verify-all-patches.ps1 -KeepIn` keep drops the last run's stamp before it starts, so a half-finished keep never passes for a whole one.

- Changelog entries don't open with an "Instagram:" label anymore, since HushGram only patches Instagram. A topic like `Glass tab bar:` stays. The release notes and Manager's text drop a leftover label, and `release_notes.py --drop-labels` clears it at the cut.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.5.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `454.0.0.54.77`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

What was checked

9281 runtime tests passed locally. All 2628 patch tests passed too.

HushMessenger for Messenger 586.0.0.55.92, 6 arm64 and armv7 builds, which needs Morphe Manager 2.4.0 or newer. 88 patches. Calls have their own section now, with switches to record a call or ask before one starts. Hold a message and its actions come up in your own order, and old chats can be searched through the messages your phone kept. Light mode can take a color, and the People tab can come back on accounts that lost it. Source updates don't change installed apps.

### New in this release

- `Clone install under another package name` has a new option, `Facebook package to open`. Put a Facebook clone's ID there (like `com.facebook.katana.morphe`) and a Messenger clone opens profiles, shared stories and other Facebook links in that clone, and checks for it instead of the regular app when it asks whether Facebook is installed. Sign-in and account sharing still use the regular Facebook app. (Hushfacebook #348)
- `Search saved messages` is a new switch under Conversations, for old chats Messenger's own search finds nothing in. It adds a button to a chat's search results that looks through the messages this phone has saved for that chat, and tapping a result opens the chat there. It works in chats that aren't end-to-end encrypted. It can only find what the phone has loaded, so the screen says how far back it got, and scrolling up in the chat loads more. It reads Messenger's data without changing it, and it starts off. Refs #92.
- `Record calls` is a new switch under Calls. During a call it puts a Record button over Messenger, and the call goes into one sound file in Recordings/Messenger Calls on your phone (Music/Messenger Calls on Android 10 and 11). While it's on, calls use Android's regular audio path instead of Messenger's own, and Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Messenger doesn't tell the other people, and recording laws differ from place to place, so get everyone's OK first. It needs Android 10 or newer. It's experimental for now and starts off. Refs #105.
- `Hide call buttons` is a new switch under Calls. It takes the audio and video call buttons out of a chat's top bar, so a tap meant for something else can't start an awkward call. Calls still ring, and you can still join one that's going. Refs #121.
- `Save button for voice messages` is a new switch under Photos and videos. Hold a voice message, tap More, and Save voice message is at the top, for keeping just that one. It lands in the same folder as `Save voice messages you play`, which can stay off. Refs #123.
- The message log got easier to get around in. There's a search box that looks through words and names and doesn't care about accents, and `Group by chat` lists your chats so you can open one. `Save as text` and `Save as CSV` write what's showing to a file you pick, and `Save messages before they're removed` adds each message to a text file in Download/Messenger just before the log drops it, one file a month. Saved files aren't encrypted, so that switch starts off, and it needs Android 10 or newer. Refs #127.
- `Row in the Menu tab` is a new switch under `Keep a message log`. It puts a Message log row in Messenger's Menu tab, right under the HushMessenger one, and tapping it opens the log without going through settings first. It starts off, and it shows on patches that have `Open settings from menu`. Refs #133.
- `Preview chats on long press` is a new switch under Inbox. Press and hold a chat and you get a peek at the conversation with the chat's menu under it, instead of the menu alone. It's Messenger's own preview, which Meta only gives some accounts, so it looks and works like Messenger's. Refs #134.
- `Show People tab` is a new switch under Navigation. On accounts where Messenger took the People tab out of the bottom bar, it puts it back right after Chats. If `Hide People tab` is on too, the tab stays hidden. Restart Messenger to see it. Refs #136.
- `Customize message actions` is a new switch under Conversations. Hold a message and its actions come up in the order you set, without the ones you hid. Messages you sent and messages you got get separate lists in settings, and each fills in the first time you hold one of those messages. The first actions go in the row of buttons and the rest go under More, which keeps your order instead of moving Messenger's picks to the top. `Reset to Messenger's order` puts a list back. It starts off. Refs #144.
- The message log does more now. `Direct` and `Groups` at the top split one-to-one chats from group chats, and a chat that shows up with no name can get one you pick, which search finds too. Photos people send you get their own entry, and when Messenger's notification carries a preview picture the log keeps that too, encrypted like the words. You also pick how long messages stay (30 days, 90 days, a year or until you clear the log), and the log holds up to 5,000 now instead of 500. `Button at the top of Chats` puts a clock next to the new message button that opens the log. Refs #131.
- `Keep the search bar` is a new switch under Inbox. Some accounts lost the search bar above their chats when Messenger moved search behind an icon, and this brings the bar back and drops the icon. Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Accounts that never got the icon see no change. It's still experimental, so it starts off. Refs #128.
- `Ask before a call` is a new switch under Calls. Tapping the audio or video call button in a chat asks "Start a voice call?" or "Start a video call?" first, so a stray tap doesn't ring anyone. Call starts it and Cancel doesn't. Calls coming in aren't affected. Refs #130.
- `Jump to the first message or a date` is a new switch under Conversations. Long press a chat's name at the top of the chat and pick the first message or a day. Messenger only loads a chat a page at a time, so it scrolls back with a count at the bottom of the screen until it gets there, and Cancel stops it. Refs #130.
- Calls have their own section in settings and in Morphe's patch list now, so `Quiet incoming calls` sits there next to the other call switches instead of under Conversations. Refs #130.
- Light mode can have a color now. `Unlock app themes` is a new switch under Theme that lets you pick any theme in Messenger's own Theme setting without a subscription, and the check moves to the theme you tap right away instead of after you leave the page. Material You also got a `Light mode accent` switch, which gives Messenger's blues in light mode your accent while grays and white stay put. Pick that accent from the new row of colors in Appearance, or keep your wallpaper's. Refs #132.
- `Report a problem` now also says whether Messenger's notifications can pop up on your phone. It fills in Android's notification switch for Messenger, your chat bubbles choice, whether Messenger may draw over other apps and show calls full screen, and which notification channels sit below the level that pops up. Channels are listed by Messenger's own id for them, so no chat names end up in the report. Refs #126.
- `Your own home header` is a new switch under Theme. Type a few words or pick a picture and it shows at the top of the chat list in place of Messenger's wordmark. Words take the wordmark's own colors, gradient and dark mode white included, and stand as tall as its letters in the same spot. A picture keeps its colors, sits at that height too and wins when both are set. With neither, the wordmark stays. Refs #129.
- Quick setups has an `iPhone look` choice now. One tap puts a Chats title over your chat list in place of the wordmark and keeps the search bar under it, the way Messenger looks on an iPhone. It turns on `Your own home header` and `Keep the search bar`, and it only fills in the header's words when you haven't picked any (or a picture). Undo takes it all back. Restart Messenger to see it. Refs #136.
- The HushMessenger settings icon in the app drawer has a blue gear of its own now, and its name comes from the app's resources the way Messenger's does. Some launchers (one on a realme phone) showed it as a second Messenger icon with Messenger's name. The text menu's Bold and Italic rows get the same treatment, and so do Restart Messenger and a clone's app name, and the settings name follows your language where the settings page does. Refs #141, #125.
- `Hide pictures on the Blocked list` is a new switch under Privacy. The list of people you've blocked, in Privacy and safety, keeps their names and Unblock but drops their profile pictures, the same way Messenger already shows someone it can't look up. It starts off. (Hushfacebook #361)
- `Allow landscape` is a new switch under Conversations. Messenger turns sideways with your phone when auto-rotate is on, so you get a wider keyboard and bigger photos and videos, and a photo or video you close doesn't snap the screen back upright. Calls, the camera, payments and a few other screens stay upright. Messenger needs a restart after you change it. It starts off while it's experimental. Refs #140.
- `Hide chosen chats` is a new switch under Inbox. Press and hold a chat and tap Hide from chat list, and that chat stays off your list even when new messages come in. Search still finds it. The chats you've hidden are listed under the switch with an Unhide button each, and they're kept per account on this phone. Hiding doesn't stop notifications, so mute the chat in Messenger for that. This one's experimental too, and it starts off. Refs #139.
- `Notify for restricted chats` is a new switch under Privacy. Restricting someone in Messenger also stops their messages from notifying you. With this on they notify you like any other chat, and a chat you've muted still stays quiet. End-to-end encrypted chats aren't covered, and most one-to-one chats are encrypted now. The chat stays in your restricted list, and they still can't see when you're active or when you've read their messages. It's experimental and it starts off. Refs #143.

### Fixes and changes

- HushMessenger now targets Messenger 586.0.0.55.92. 585.0.0.53.94 is no longer supported, so update Messenger before you patch. Arm64 phones can use builds 347215257, 347215330, 347215343, 347215344 or 347215348, and 347215257 and 347215343 are the nodpi ones with icons for every screen. Each was checked patch by patch, and Morphe Desktop applied and rebuilt it. On any other 586 build the patch stops before it changes anything, so pick one of those five. Refs #137, #145.
- Messenger 586's 32-bit build (armeabi-v7a, 347215341) is supported too, so 32-bit phones can patch 586. It was checked patch by patch the same way, and Morphe Desktop applied and rebuilt it. Refs #106.
- The patches are built with Morphe's patcher 2.2.0 now, so they need Morphe Manager 2.4.0 or newer, or Morphe Desktop 2.0.0 or newer. Refs #137, #138.
- `Hide Meta AI` also hides Meta AI's offer to summarize the messages you haven't read. That's the "Summarize N unread messages" pill over a chat and the Summarize link on the unread divider. They're never built, so they don't leave a gap. Refs #142.
- Chat heads show up for messages that arrive while Messenger is still running in the background, once you allow it unrestricted battery use. On Optimized battery Android blocks the chat head in that case, so one only appeared if Messenger had been closed. `Allow chat bubbles` now has an `Allow unrestricted battery use` button under its modes that asks Android for it, and its help text says why.
- Coming back to HushMessenger's settings from an Android screen, like `Android bubble settings`, keeps your place in the list. If you'd searched first, the list used to jump back up to the search box.
- Someone who calls you while HushMessenger's settings sit open behind Messenger now shows up under `Only chosen chats` when you go back to settings. The list used to stay as it was until you left settings and opened them again.
- `Pin more chats` works now. A fourth pin used to end in Messenger's "Can't pin chat", because the limit lives on Meta's servers and nothing on the phone can talk them out of it. Pins past the limit now stay on your phone instead. They go to the top with the pin mark and stay there after a restart, and you unpin them the usual way. They won't show on your other devices. Chats that don't offer Pin at all get it back the same way. Turn the switch off or pause HushMessenger and those pins step aside until you turn it back on. Refs #56, #60, #47.
- `Record calls` no longer tries to post its notification on Android 13 and newer when Messenger isn't allowed to show notifications. The call still records and saves, and the button over the call says it's recording.
- **Restore screens on re-signed builds** changes nothing when it can't place its push service fix in a Messenger build. It used to have the signature answer in place already by the time it gave up.
- If a part of HushMessenger that starts with Messenger can't load, Messenger opens anyway and only that part stays off. Before, a class that failed to load at that moment could close Messenger before safe mode had a chance to run.
- New messages pop up at the top of the screen again on a phone where they'd stopped. While chat heads were on, Messenger lowered its Chats notification channel for good, and only Meta's server flags ever raised it back, so the pop-ups stayed gone even with chat heads turned off. **Keep chat pop-ups** is a new patch with no switch that stops the lowering and raises the channel at the next start. It leaves the channel alone if you changed it yourself in Android's settings, and picking `Chat heads` under `Allow chat bubbles` keeps Messenger's own behavior. Refs #126.
- `Mark as read button` now shows up in chats whose top bar was full with no chat details button to replace, like a chat with a Label button, an Add friend button, a Meta AI button or a group's home button next to the call buttons. It takes the place of a button that isn't for calls there, so the call buttons still stay put. Refs #122.
- Android Auto's launcher opens Messenger again instead of showing the HushMessenger settings entry in its place. The drawer entry now sorts after Messenger's own, so anything that launches Messenger by package name lands in Messenger, like Android Auto or the Facebook app's Messenger button. A Manager's Open button does the same. The `Android Auto messages` text now says Unknown sources is only enough on a desktop head unit, since a real car can still leave Messenger out, and that playing a message aloud marks the chat read and shows Seen, even with `Hide read receipts` on. Refs #75.
- With `Open your gallery app`, a photo or video from Google Photos no longer crashes Messenger when the folder it copies your pick into won't take the file. The copy moves to another of Messenger's own folders and the send carries on, and **Report a problem** says which folder refused and why. Refs #124.
- `Bold and italic text` now puts Bold and Italic straight into the chat box's text menu, by name, with nothing to tick first on a Samsung phone. On some Samsung phones those two rows showed up as Messenger and Messenger, and they brought Dictionary, Translate and other apps' rows into the chat box along with them. Those rows are gone from the chat box again. Refs #125.
- `Check for updates` can't close Messenger anymore when the check breaks in a way it didn't plan for. It says it couldn't check, the same as when you're offline, and **Report a problem** picks up what went wrong.
- Saving your choices to a file now says "Couldn't save your choices to the file" when that fails. It used to show the clipboard's message. A restore that only gets some of them back reads like "Restored 3 of 5 choices." now.
- A switch that stopped with an error doesn't keep saying so after you repatch. That error came from the older patch, so the line under the switch and `Copy setup` now leave it out until the new one hits a problem of its own. A part that keeps failing also logs once a minute instead of every time the screen redraws.
- In a right-to-left language the arrows on the settings sections point the right way. A closed section's arrow pointed up and an open one's pointed down.
- TalkBack reads a settings section's name and count first. It used to say "Collapsed, Button" before the name.
- Buttons in the Hush settings with a short label like "OK" are at least 48 dp wide now, so they're as easy to hit as the taller ones.
- The Hush settings page has a new layout, the one HushGram uses, drawn in Messenger's colors. It opens on the HushMessenger logo and name, and the name moves up into the top bar once you scroll past it. Right under the name is the search box, with `Show all settings as a list` below it if you'd rather see every switch at once. Sections are cards now, each row with its own icon. Sheets got bigger titles and buttons that are easier to tell apart, and the restart bar sits at the bottom of the screen. Dark mode is true black and light mode follows the same layout. Switches are squared off, with the thumb inside the track. The HushMessenger name and the other titles drift through Messenger's blues, sky to royal, and the pink and orange are gone.
- A switch that can't work on your phone says why on a line of its own now, at full strength. The reason used to be dimmed along with the switch, and it was hard to read. `Log out` does the same with the line that says where to log out instead.
- Buttons that remove something are red, like `Clear log` and `Remove the picture`, or the one that removes an auto reply or its picture, and they look grayed out while they can't be used. Text boxes have a thicker outline that turns red while what's in one needs fixing, and an empty auto reply now says "Write a reply here, or remove this one before saving."
- The `Shared install` help is an amber warning now, since uninstalling Messenger from there removes its data too. The note that auto reply is off sits in a box of its own instead of one that looked like a text field.
- Cards in settings, the sheets, the message log and the restart screen all use the same corners and padding.
- A search left typed on the Controls tab doesn't rename the App tab's top bar anymore.
- In the message log, a chat's name is in the link color when tapping it opens that chat.
- `Search saved messages` shows each result as its own card with room between them, and a long message ends in "…". Tapping Search with nothing typed says to type a word first instead of doing nothing.
- Picking an accent color, `Use copied theme`, `Back to wallpaper colors` and `Remove the picture` under `Your own home header` can all be undone with Undo at the top of settings. The color dots and the Record button over a call show your tap now.
- Settings stay put under your finger. Undo showing up at the top, or going away 10 seconds later, used to push every row down and back up, and the note above the color dots did the same when an accent pick changed its length. The page moves with them now, so the dot or button you just tapped stays where it was.
- The bar at the bottom of a chat while `Jump to the first message or a date` scrolls back has a line along its top, and TalkBack names it when it shows up. A tap beside Cancel no longer lands on the chat box under it.
- When an update is out, `View release` is the main button under `Check for updates`, and a check that fails says so in red.
- An auto reply picture with see-through parts, like a logo saved as a PNG, goes out on white. Those parts used to turn black.

### Behind the scenes

- The How to update step in the release notes lists the version codes the release was checked against, instead of saying any build on APKMirror works. v0.28.0's notes said that, and then APKMirror posted 17 more 585 builds that v0.28.0 doesn't take, newer `nodpi` ones included. Refs #138, #145.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` no longer taps anything on Messenger's chat restore prompt, as its own notes always said. When the prompt turns up in front of a later screen, the walk opens the chat link to get past it and then opens that screen again, the way it already did for the chat list. `-Thread` has to be a chat's numeric user id now, and a walk given `-Serial` without `-OutDir` keeps its steps and receipt in a folder for that phone, so walks on two phones at once don't clear each other's.
- `scripts/CompatReport.java --save` records a new Messenger build now instead of failing because the build isn't recorded yet. Without `--save` that build still fails. A damaged APK or a broken line in a record gets one line naming the file and exit code 2, not a Java stack trace.

### How to update

1. Update Messenger to 586.0.0.55.92 first. On [APKMirror's 586.0.0.55.92 page](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-586-0-0-55-92-release/), take a build whose version code is 347215257, 347215330, 347215341, 347215343, 347215344 or 347215348. APKMirror shows the code for each download, and a build posted there after this release may not be supported yet.
2. In Morphe Manager (2.4.0 or newer), open **Sources** and refresh HushMessenger. The card should say **88 patches**.
3. Patch Messenger again and install it over your current one. Your settings carry over.

Patching on a computer? `patches-0.29.0.mpp` below is the same bundle for Morphe Desktop 2.0.0 or newer. It's a patch bundle, not a Messenger APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` and its signature let you check the download, and the README says how.

### What was checked

- The full test suite, plus a patch run against all 6 Messenger 586.0.0.55.92 builds on file.
- Morphe Desktop patched and rebuilt one APK from each of the 2 build families.
- An APK patched from this exact bundle was installed on an emulator on Android API 32, signed in to Messenger. A chat, the inbox, both HushMessenger settings tabs, the message log, auto reply, Messenger's own settings, story settings and contact settings all opened, with no crashes.

This one stays on Facebook 585.0.0.47.54 and Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer, so just update the patches and repatch. The Hush settings got a new look with a `Switches that are on` list and a Custom accent color. New switches put a post's photos in a carousel, turn Reels gray, start a break after 20 reels, translate or hide posts in other languages, and add a seek bar and a full player button to feed videos. Stories can get a play button and a progress bar along the bottom. There are plenty of fixes too, like comments that stopped loading after the first ten and Back from a post jumping the feed to the top.

New in this release

- New `Open full screen videos centered` under Video and audio. A video you open in Facebook's full screen player, from a comment or a link, starts with its details and comments folded away, so a wide video sits in the middle of the screen instead of up at the top. The arrow under it still opens the panel. It's off by default. (#242)

- New `Dim around a zoom` under `Pinch to zoom`. Turn it off and the rest of the screen stays as it is while you zoom into a photo or story, instead of going dark behind it. It's on by default, so zooms look the same as before until you change it. (#220)

- New `Keep videos playing while zoomed` under `Pinch to zoom`. A video you zoom into on a profile or Page keeps playing under your fingers, where it used to stop on the frame it showed. With `Stay zoomed` on too, press and hold the zoom to pause the video and hold again to play it. Stories still hold still while you zoom. It's off by default. (#220)

- New `Search photo in post menus`, right under `Save photo in post menus`. A post with one photo gets Search photo in its three-dot menu, and a tap hands that photo to the app you pick, like Google Lens, so you can find out what's in it or copy the text out of it. The photo comes from Facebook's servers at the biggest size the post has, and only the app you pick can read it. It's off by default and needs `Save any photo` on. (#245, #248)

- New `Show Reels in gray` under Reels and Watch, with the other `Clean up Reels` switches. The Reels screen shows in black and white, buttons, caption and video alike, which makes it a little easier to put down. Your feed, stories, photos and chats keep their colors, and so does a reel you download. A video you open full screen from the feed can go gray too, since it plays on a screen like Reels. A swipe between reels doesn't flash color, and the colors come back when you leave Reels. It starts from the next reel after you turn it on, because the reel's player has to draw with the rest of the screen for its video to go gray, so this needs the `Turn off HDR brightness` patch in your build too. It's off by default and costs a little battery on Reels.

- New `Also after 20 reels` under `Take breaks`. With it on, a break also starts once you've watched 20 different reels, if that comes before your `Break after` time. A reel counts after it's played for 3 seconds, so ones you swipe past right away don't, and watching the same reel again doesn't count twice. Ads and live videos never count. The count starts over after a break, after time away as long as a break, and when the switch is turned off, and it survives a restart of Facebook. It's off by default and needs the `Resume long videos` patch, which is what notices reels playing. (#248)

- New `Full player button on feed videos` under Video and audio, right below `Inline feed video controls`. It puts a button next to play that opens the video in Facebook's own full player with all its controls, and a video playing in the feed stops first. Live videos get it too. It starts off, and with Tap to play on it needs `Inline feed video controls` on as well. (#239)

- New `Clean up the story viewer` under Stories, with three switches. `Hide song and effect credits` takes the song or effect credit off the line under the poster's name. A line that only showed the credit goes away, and one that switched back and forth keeps just its usual text. A story Facebook labels Trending or Suggested keeps its line as it was, so the label isn't lost. `Hide reply suggestions` takes away the row of suggested replies at the bottom of a story, and the reply box stays. `Progress bar at the bottom` draws a thin bar along the bottom of a story that fills as it plays, like the one on Reels. All three start off, and the first two apply from the next story you open. (#380)

- New `Story viewer taps` under Stories, with two switches. `Story play button` puts a play and pause button on a story when you tap its middle, the way Reels does. It fades away a couple of seconds after the story plays again, and taps on the sides still change stories. `Double tap for next story` makes stories change only on a double tap (the left side goes back, anywhere else goes forward), so a single tap pauses or plays the story instead, or brings up the button when that's on. The pause is Facebook's own. Both start off. (#380)

- New `Block button on reaction lists` under Comments and writing, next to `Block button on comments`. In the list of people who reacted to a post, the button at the end of each row (Add friend, Message, Confirm and the like) says Block, and a tap opens Facebook's own block screen for that person, with its usual question before anything is blocked. Your own row and rows Facebook shows no button on stay as they are. It's off by default, and a change shows on lists opened after it. (#271)

- New `GmsCore support` patch for phones without Google Play services, so Facebook gets its push notifications through microG-RE. It's off by default and only shows in Expert mode, since on a phone with Google Play services Facebook would stop getting push.

- New `Open in Facebook from the share menu` patch. Messenger keeps facebook.com links in its own browser, so share the page from there (or the link from any app) and pick Open in Facebook, and it opens in the patched Facebook. Hushfacebook settings lists it under Built-in changes, with a line on how to use it. (#111)

- New `Let each post come back once` under `Hide posts you've already seen`. A post counts as seen after a quarter second on screen, so a quick scroll used to hide plenty you never read. With this on, a post you scrolled past shows up one more time, and it's hidden once you scroll past it again. It starts off. (#186)

- Hushfacebook now tells you when Facebook's icons look soft because of the download you patched. The 32-bit bundle only has images for 320 dpi screens, so on a sharper screen the Home, bell, Profile, Search and Messenger icons get enlarged and look blurry. On a phone that can run the 64-bit bundle, a short note says so once after you install, and a line under the status card in the settings names the bundle to patch instead. (#365)

- New `Hide Up next on videos` under Reels and Watch. It takes the UP NEXT bar, with the next video's name and length, off the bottom of a video you open from the feed. Off by default. (#367)

- `Show the post date on reels` now dates older reels too. Past the first week Facebook often leaves the date out, so an older reel showed nothing under the poster's name even with the switch on. Pull to refresh still works. (#378)

That also stops the top of the next reel from peeking in under the video, in a profile's reels and in videos you open from the feed. (#375, #358)

It used to be missing for a second or so while the reel viewer caught up with the video the feed had been playing. For that moment the bar now sits at the start, then jumps to where the reel is and keeps moving. (#359)

- With `Hide seen stories` and `View stories anonymously` both on, a story Facebook has shown as watched once now stays hidden until that person posts a new one, even after a restart or a refresh that sends it as unwatched. The switch used to ask the phone's video decoder to convert those reels itself, and some phones' conversion shifted the colors. Now the reel goes over in its own colors and Android fits them to the screen, which is what Snapdragon phones already got. I've only watched it on a Snapdragon phone so far. (#93)

(#364)

Behind the scenes

- Changelog entries don't open with a "Facebook:" label anymore. Hushfacebook only patches Facebook, so it repeated itself on every line. The release scripts stopped adding or asking for it, and they drop it from any bullet that still has one when a release is cut.

- `scripts/gen-l10n.py` writes each language's table to a class of its own, since the one generated file had grown past the size lint will read. The release check also stops counting Russian plural rows as missing from the other tables when their English runs over more than one line.

- The source census leaves out GitLab forks that are waiting to be deleted. Someone keeps forking the GitLab sources and deleting the copies again within a few hours, so every census flagged forks that were already gone.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.3.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `585.0.0.47.54`. On most phones that's build `476015655`, the arm64-v8a one. Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `476015543`, the armeabi-v7a one.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

What was checked

Local checks passed: 5705 tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 117 patches applied without forcing to Facebook 585.0.0.47.54, both the 64-bit and the 32-bit build, and a second build of the same commit matched this bundle entry for entry (968 entries). I patched Facebook with this exact bundle and walked the whole app with every switch on, on an emulator signed in to a full account. 84 of 118 hook families ran there, `Photo carousel`, `Hold a reel for 2x` and `Open comments at full height` among them, all 23 settings pages opened in dark and in light, and Facebook didn't crash once. Android's verifier raised nothing on the patched build, the same as on Meta's own. The walk doesn't reach downloads, chats or the story viewer, so those are covered by the patch tests alone this time, and the 32-bit build was checked by its patch tests rather than on a device.

HushMessenger for Messenger 585.0.0.53.94, all 7 arm64 and armv7 builds, which needs Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer. 71 patches. The bundle is signed now, and new switches save the voice messages you play, put gallery picks straight into the chat and let calls from chosen people come in without a ring. Material You takes your own colors, and the settings speak Vietnamese. Source updates don't change installed apps.

### New in this release

- `Quiet incoming calls` has a new **Only chosen chats** switch under it. Turn it on, then pick from the people who called you lately (they're listed newest first), and only their calls come in without a ring. Everyone else rings as usual. Refs #117.
- `Android Auto messages` is a new switch under Conversations. Android Auto only reads a message out and takes a spoken reply when the notification has a mark-as-read action, and Messenger's don't, so Auto fell back to treating them as plain alerts. With the switch on, each message notification carries Messenger's own car mark-as-read as an action you never see on the phone, right next to Messenger's Reply. Android Auto only lists apps installed from the Play Store until you turn on Unknown sources in its developer settings. It's experimental and starts off. Refs #75.
- `Hide the Instants button` is a new switch under Inbox. It hides the + button that slides in at the right edge of your chat list and opens Instants, on every 585 build. Not every account gets that button, so the switch is experimental. Refs #118.
- `Hide the Instants button` also covers the Instants button under your chat heads, the one that sits right where your thumb goes when you reach for a chat. Refs #104.
- `Save voice messages you play` is a new switch under Photos and videos. Each voice message you play also lands in Recordings/Messenger on your phone (Music/Messenger on Android 10 and 11), so a file manager or another player can open it later. Playing the same one again doesn't make a second copy. It needs Android 10 or newer and starts off. Refs #90.
- `Put gallery picks in the chat` is a new switch under Photos and videos that goes with `Open your gallery app`. ### Fixes and changes

- On a Samsung phone, `Bold and italic text` now tells you where to switch Bold and Italic on. Samsung keeps other apps' entries out of the text menu until you tick them under the three dots and Manage apps, so turning on the switch alone looked like it did nothing. Refs #42.
- The README's troubleshooting list now covers a login that gets past the password and then loops on a browser check. That's an account with a passkey, and removing the passkey on the web lets Facebook fall back to approving the login from another device. Refs #108.
- HushMessenger now targets Messenger 585.0.0.53.94 and takes all 7 builds APKMirror lists for it, five for arm64 and two for armv7. 584.1.0.61.98 is no longer supported, so update Messenger before you patch. Each build was checked patch by patch, and Morphe Desktop applied and rebuilt every one of them.
- `Hide Facebook shortcuts` now also hides the View profile button under the person's name and picture at the top of a chat with no messages yet. It opened their Facebook profile. With `Keep the Profile button` on, that one stays too.
- `Hide inbox tabs` now says what it hides on 585: the All, Unread and Groups tabs above your chats. The old text named Home and Channels tabs Messenger doesn't show anymore. Checked on 585, where On hides the tabs and Off or Pause brings them back.
- With `Open your gallery app`, a photo or video you pick in Google Photos that's already saved on your phone now reaches Messenger as the phone's own copy, which Messenger reads with its own photo and video access. Before, the upload had to go through Google Photos' permission. Items that only live in the cloud, and anything Messenger can't open itself, go through as picked. Refs #103.
- Opening a new issue on GitHub now offers a bug report form and a feature request form. The bug form asks for your versions, how you got your patched Messenger (Morphe Manager, Morphe Desktop, morphe-cli or a prebuilt APK), which patches source you added, the phone and where in Messenger it happened, so a report can be looked into without a round of questions first. Other sources carry HushMessenger's patches built from other code, and the source address tells them apart. **App > Report a problem** still opens a blank issue with those facts already filled in.
- The README's Install step says what Manager 2.3 and newer shows as this project's signing key, and its Help section explains the "Key changed" badge. It means the bundle was signed with another key and came from somewhere other than this source, so remove that source and add this one again instead of tapping Trust.
- The README's Help section explains why videos can go missing from Messenger's own picker on Android 14 and newer: with Messenger's photo access set to "Allow limited access" the picker shows only the items you chose. "Allow all" or `Open your gallery app` brings them back. Refs #114.
- With `Square profile pictures` on, the story ring around a picture in your chat list is square too, or rounded with **Round the corners**, so it hugs the picture instead of circling it. A ring that's still filling in follows the same edge. The ring part is experimental. Refs #116.
- `Hide stories and notes` also takes away the story rings around people's pictures in your chat list, the colored circle that says someone posted. It works with or without `Square profile pictures`, and like the square ring it's experimental. Refs #118.
- The patches are built with Morphe patcher 2.1.0 now, the patcher that comes with Morphe Manager 2.3.0 and Morphe Desktop 1.20.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.3.0 or newer, or Desktop to 1.20.0, before you add this release.

### Behind the scenes

- The release check reads the bug form's version placeholder and refuses a release where it names another HushMessenger version or a Messenger build the bundle doesn't target. Prepare moves it along with the README.
- The release check reads which patcher built the bundle from its manifest and wants the README to ask for the first Morphe Manager and Morphe Desktop that come with it. Install steps can't send anyone to a Manager too old to load the release. Between releases the README keeps naming what the published release needs.
- The release check refuses a bundle holding a class file compiled for anything newer than Java 17 and names the entry, since morphe-patcher 2.1 won't load one. Entries under `META-INF/versions/` are left alone, as the patcher leaves them.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` now patches the stock APK of the build the device already runs when you don't pass `-Apk`. It reads the installed version code and picks that build from `HUSH_NATIVE_FIXTURES`, so the install no longer dies on `INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE` or lands a different ABI or screen density. When no fixture is that build, it stops and says which builds it has.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` now waits up to 90 seconds after it installs Messenger, until the chat list or the restore prompt shows. The first start after an update upgrades Messenger's data, and until that's done a chat link opens a blank screen. On an x86_64 emulator, a crash inside the emulator's ARM translator while Messenger forks a helper process is still reported, but it no longer counts as a Messenger crash, since a phone doesn't run that translator.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` closes the keyboard before it reads each screen. A chat with no messages yet puts the cursor in the message box, the keyboard comes up, and with it open the screen read failed, so the walk reported the chat as having no screen to check. The keyboard can also come up a moment after the chat loads, so the walk checks again after closing it and tries the screen read up to three times.
- Publish now writes the GitHub release notes in the layout v0.27.0's notes were redone in by hand. They open with the release summary, then carry every CHANGELOG bullet word for word under New in this release, Fixes and changes and Behind the scenes, followed by the reports the release touched, How to update, and What was checked, which comes from the walk that cleared the bundle. Publish stops before tagging when a bullet would go missing or a line uses a dash.
- The release check refuses a bundle that isn't signed, was signed with a key other than the one in `morphe-signing.pub`, or was changed after signing. It also wants that key in the source's `public_key` and its fingerprint in the README. `release.ps1` reads the private key from `-BundleKey` and the build signs with it, while everyday builds without the key stay unsigned.
- The settings screen's code is split up. Auto reply's sheet, the message log viewer, theme colors, the choices backup, the custom font rows, the update check and Copy setup each have a file of their own now, which takes the settings page itself from about 3,600 lines to about 1,500. Nothing you see or tap changed.
- The build moved to Gradle 9.8.2 and Kotlin 2.4.21, both bugfix releases. The patches used to mix Kotlin 2.4.20 and 2.4.21 across the compiler, plugin and library, and now one version covers all three. The bundle's classes still target Java 11.
